title: My Lucky Star
description: This is a romantic drama set against the backdrop of power, identity, and social justice. The story follows Akira, a brave village girl who enters a forced marriage with Lakshya, a billionaire who hides his identity as a poor caterer. While Akira joins the Vardhan Group to stop the demolition of her village’s livelihood, Lakshya secretly helps her while maintaining his disguise. Their relationship evolves from awkward strangers to partners who fight injustice together. The show explores themes of class divide, hidden identity, ambition, love, and rural empowerment. With humour, romance, and emotional confrontations, the narrative builds towards Akira proving that compassion and roots are more powerful than wealth.

title: Still a Family
description: In 2015, Tongzhou officially became the sub-center of Beijing, and the people were very happy. Sai Duoxi's family, who lived in the alley of the old wharf of the North Canal and were doing renovation, received the demolition payment as promised. The five brothers and sisters of the Sai family quarreled over the demolition payment. In the process, the hidden problems of each family were exposed one after another. Sai Duoxi was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Facing his children who were like a pile of scattered sand, he was always unable to treat them equally, and he fell into distress and reflection. His greatest wish was to see his children live in harmony before he died, and this hope could only be placed on his eldest daughter-in-law Wen Jiayin. Wen Jiayin, the eldest sister-in-law who was always gentle and docile but determined in her heart, began to clean up the "mess" of the Sai family in the name of her family. With her efforts and inspiration, the five brothers and sisters finally corrected their shortcomings according to their father's expectations, united, turned danger into safety, and realized their father's long-cherished wish of "family harmony brings prosperity".

title: The Early Spring
description: Fresh graduate Shang Zhitao joins a top global ad agency as a rookie. Her blunt boss Luan Nian tells her to quit on day one, but she perseveres through pressure and challenges to become a skilled professional.

title: Computer Basics
description:
In this video playlist, you’ll get to know the basics of getting started using computers. Visit https://www.gcflearnfree.org/computerbasics/ for our text-based tutorial.

With this video series, you’ll learn more about the types of computers and operating systems in use today. You'll also gain a better understanding of the basic parts of a computer, how applications are used, connecting to the Internet, and more.

We hope you enjoy!

title: Programming for Kids and Beginners: Learn to Code in Scratch 3.0
description:
Now with Scratch 3.0: learn to program, create games, have fun in Scratch! For kids and beginners, parents and teachers!

In this course, we'll learn to code, starting from the basic blocks. No kidding! Scratch, the programming language we use (developed by MIT), is so fun that it makes programming seem like a game.

We'll learn by doing. The course is designed so that you create the games and applications with your own two hands. But what makes this course truly unique is the teaching method I've used live for almost 4 years. We learn a variety of computer science topics, but we hide the complexity behind characters, animations, analogies and fun!

That's because, in these carefully designed lessons, we train our intuition to make sense of what we want to achieve and how to get there. This will help you quickly master the basics. After this course, you'll learn text-based programming languages at a blazing speed and quickly make sense of any piece of code.

The content is designed to be fun! We learn to create animations and cool effects and we create clones of some of the most popular games: Flappy Bird, Duck Hunt or Pac-Man. The games are handpicked to optimize learning computer science topics while having fun along the way. I will also update the course on a regular basis with new content - and challenges!

This course is designed for

parents or teachers who want to give their children the best skills and most fun
kids and beginners who want to learn to code games
anyone new to programming who doesn't know where to start
I can't wait to have you in the course!

The course is regularly updated with new material, tips and tricks that you can use in your games and projects!

Who this course is for:
Children (from 7-8 years)
Absolute beginners in programming and computer science

title: Excel Basics for Data Analysis
description:
Spreadsheet tools like Excel are an essential tool for working with data - whether for data analytics, business, marketing, or research. This course is designed to give you a basic working knowledge of Excel and how to use it for analyzing data. 
 
This course is suitable for those who are interested in pursuing a career in data analysis or data science, as well as anyone looking to use Excel for data analysis in their own domain. No prior experience with spreadsheets or coding is required - all you need is a device with a modern web browser and the ability to create a Microsoft account to access Excel online at no cost. If you have a desktop version of Excel, you can also easily follow along with the course. 
 
Throughout this course, you'll gain valuable experience working with data sets and spreadsheets. We'll start by introducing you to spreadsheets like Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, and show you how to load data from multiple formats. From there, you'll learn how to perform basic data wrangling and cleansing tasks using functions, and expand your knowledge of data analysis through the use of filtering, sorting, and pivot tables. 
 
There is a strong focus on practice and applied learning in this course. With each lab, you'll have the opportunity to manipulate data and gain hands-on experience using Excel. You'll learn how to clean and format your data efficiently, and convert it into a pivot table to make it more organized and readable. The final project will allow you to showcase your newly acquired data analysis skills by working with real data sets and spreadsheets. 
 
By the end of this course, you'll have a solid foundation in using Excel for data analysis. You'll have worked with multiple data sets and spreadsheets, and will have the skills and knowledge needed to effectively clean and analyze data without having to learn any code. So let's get started!

title: Linux System Programming and Introduction to Buildroot
description:
This course provides an overview of System Programming for the Linux operating system, or software which is interfacing directly with the Linux Kernel and C library. The basic components of a Linux Embedded System, including kernel and root filesystem details are discussed. The Buildroot build system is introduced, which students use to build their own custom Embedded Linux system through programming assignments.
Linux System Programming and Introduction to Buildroot can also be taken for academic credit as ECEA 5305, part of CU Boulder’s Master of Science in Electrical Engineering.

title: Excel Skills for Business: Essentials
description:
In this first course of the specialization, 'Excel Skills for Business: Essentials', you will master the fundamental capabilities of Microsoft Excel. Over six weeks, you will gain the confidence to expertly navigate the Excel user interface, perform essential calculations using formulas and functions, professionally format spreadsheets, and create impactful data visualizations with charts and graphs.
This course is designed for aspiring business professionals, students, and anyone looking to enhance their digital skills. Whether you are new to Excel or self-taught and aiming to solidify your foundational knowledge for greater efficiency and productivity, this program provides a robust starting point. You will solve a variety of practical business problems, applying learned Excel skills and techniques through downloadable workbooks and real-world data sets.
To succeed in this course, no prior Excel experience is required. You will develop highly valuable spreadsheet software skills, positioning yourself for success in today's rapidly evolving digital job market.

title: Introduction To Cybersecurity Course Online
description: The Foundations of Cybersecurity Program is designed to introduce you to one of the most critical and fast-growing fields in today’s digital world. As technology continues to shape businesses, governments, and everyday life, the need for cybersecurity professionals who can protect data, systems, and people has never been greater.

title: She and Her Perfect Husband [Hindi]
description: Single female lawyer Qin Shi is focused on her career, but was rushed into marriage by her parents. The top lawyer firm, Cheng and Hui is recruiting lawyers specializing in family affairs, and one of the requirements is to be married. Qin Wei, Qin Shi's second brother who is also a headhunter, secretly changed Qin Shi's marriage status to "married" without her permission, thus creating a fictional husband for her out of nowhere. Not knowing anything, Qin Shi was employed. Her outstanding performance earned the approval of the founder, Lao Jin. During a gathering with partners, Lao Jin recommended Qin Shi to be a legal counsel for the Association of Women Entrepreneurs. It is only then Qin Shi realizes that she is "married". Qin Shi decides to clarify the situation to Lao Jin, but at this moment her "husband" Yang Hua appears. He was forced by his mother to come for a matchmaking session with Qin Shi's competitor. Feeling angry about his mother's forceful actions, he has no choice but to seek the help of Qin Shi. Thus, the two people who are unwilling to be forced into marriage, hit it off immediately, and impulsively decide to register their marriage. However, both their parents sense something wrong with the situation. At this moment, Qin Shi's ex-boyfriend suddenly joined the law firm. Facing the numerous crisis, Qin Shi and Yang Hua begin to slowly fall for each other, and fortuitously acquire true love.

title: Desii Boy!!
description: When Munna Fashionwala, the flamboyant yet grounded heir of the legendary Tartari gaon, arrives at Mumbai Fashion Week dressed like a village eccentric, the elite fashion world ridicules him. But as one humiliation after another turns into shocking revelations, Munna is forced into a battle of identity, heritage, and cultural pride against influencers, fashion tycoons, and global experts to prove that true fashion is born from roots, not trends.

title: Return Of Lost Shehzada
description: When the heir of a multi-trillion-crore empire finally awakens from a three-year coma, he discovers his devoted girlfriend and her family sacrificed everything to fund his secret treatment while enduring brutal humiliation from abusive relatives. Reunited with his ultra-powerful billionaire parents, the newly awakened CEO unleashes absolute vengeance on their tormentors and elevates his loyal bride to the peak of wealth and status.

title: Baazigaar Baaz
description: "Baazigar Baaz" follows Dev, an elite commando known as Baaz, who attends his sister Diksha's engagement undercover in a peon's uniform. He endures extreme humiliation from her elitist fiancé, Vikas, to expose the man’s true nature. After uncovering Vikas’s fraud and infidelity, Dev reveals his identity, saves Diksha, and unites her with his trusted billionaire ally, Ambar Mehta.

title: Guns & Gulab
description:
This story is a high-voltage romantic thriller set against the backdrop of crime, power, and emotional conflict. It explores the journey of Naina, an innocent yet resilient girl, whose life takes a drastic turn when she crosses paths with Kabir Ahuja—a ruthless mafia don who falls obsessively in love with her.
The narrative blends intense romance with action, betrayal, and family drama. At its core, it questions morality, power dynamics, and the meaning of love—whether love can be forced or must be earned.
With strong emotional stakes, dramatic twists, and a dominating male protagonist versus a morally grounded female lead, the story promises a gripping mix of passion, revenge, and transformation.

title: War God Ki Wapasi
description: After returning home from war under absolute anonymity, a legendary, decorated commander known as the "War God" faces bitter rejection and humiliation from his estranged daughter and materialistic ex-wife. In the wake of this heartbreak, a powerful businesswoman from his past steps forward to defend his honor and accept him into her family.

title: Kaisa tera pyaar hai
description: After enduring years of emotional abuse and violent humiliation as a secretary for his ungrateful secret love, an undercover AI prodigy resigns to claim his rightful throne as a tech company CEO—ultimately exposing his manipulative rival's fraudulent lies and leaving his deeply regretful former boss behind for a woman who truly values his worth.

title: Satyamev Jayate
description: Satyamev Singh, an undefeated lawyer who believes in the justice system, finds his world shattered when the criminal he defends destroys his own family. Now torn between his duty and personal pain, he must decide whether to trust the law or seek justice on his own.

title: Love ki Adaalat
description: “Love Ki Adaalat” is a courtroom drama where justice battles power, manipulation, and emotions. When a poor fruit seller is blamed for an accident caused by a rich man, sharp lawyer Tanvi steps into a morally complex fight. As cases unfold, the courtroom becomes a stage for truth, love, and ethics, exposing how money and influence twist justice—and how courage can challenge it. Watch now.

title: Meri Broken Family
description: Micro Drama

title: Mastermind Buddha
description: Amit Garg sabke liye ek adhed umra ka aam mazdoor tha… uski apni family ne uski beizzati karke use marne ke liye chhod diya. CEO Meera khanna ne uski jaan bachakar use ek nayi zindagi di, par jab uski company tootne lagi, tabhi wahi 'mazdoor' uska sabse bada sahara bana. Jise sabne thukraya, usne sabko galat sabit kiya… kyunki sach yeh tha - Ki Amit ek chhupa hua scientist tha, jiska dimaag desh ke sabse bade aur khatarnak raaz likh raha tha.

title: Bhai Ka Badla
description: Kartik arrives into the family of Vivan, his sister Shivika and Dadaji, claiming that Kartik’s dad died saving Vivan when he was in a fatal accident with his parents, many years ago. Out of a sense of responsibility Shivika and dadaji decide to adopt Kartik but Vivan soon realises Kartik has ulterior motives. Kartik wants to oust Vivan from his own home and become the undeniable variz of the family.

title: Shotgun Shaadi
description: In the blood-soaked lands of Haryana, Abhimanyu Dahiya watches his father fall to the ruthless Sangwan clan and swears revenge. Years later, he returns in vengeance, destroying everything in his path… until fate binds him to Meher, his enemy’s daughter, in a marriage built on hatred. But when Abhimanyu discovers Meher is the very girl who once saved his life, his world shatters. Torn between his father’s blood and his own heart, he must choose - vengeance… or redemption. Watch Now!

title: Love under arrest
description:
Romi and Shikha’s wedding turns tragic when her father accidentally injures Romi’s mother.
Blinded by anger, Romi turns his love into hatred and pushes Shikha away.
As Shikha battles illness and heartbreak, fate separates them further.
They reunite when she loses her memory, giving Romi a second chance.
Through love and redemption, he wins her back and they start anew.

title: Kyunki Tum Hi Ho [Hindi]
description: At the center is Shanaya Mehra, a woman trapped between a toxic husband Arjun Raichand and the scheming Rhea Malhotra, who will do anything to take her place. Every episode unfolds with high-voltage confrontations, tears, and shocking revelations—where loyalty is tested, lies unravel, and survival becomes Shanaya’s only fight.

title: Tapori Ki CEO Girlfriend
description: A broke delivery rider, Uday, accidentally crosses paths with Sameera, a powerful CEO. A simple accident spirals into misunderstandings, street fights, unlikely friendships, and a contract marriage request that changes everything. As two worlds collide, Uday must navigate pride, poverty, and opportunity in a city where luck can flip in a heartbeat.

title: Toofani Bodyguard
description: A mysterious Kalaripayattu warrior, Krishna with a forgotten past becomes the shield of a brilliant pharma CEO, Rutvi who discovers a cancer cure - only to discover that their destinies, love, and a decades-old vendetta were bound long before fate reunited them. Watch now!

title: Pyaar on Road
description: A street-smart Jaipur Uber driver Prakriti and gentle empire heir Akshay Middha can’t stand each other, until a forced contract marriage slowly turns dislike into love, and boardroom conspiracies, jealous Suhani, and drug-running cousin Tanmay turn their fake vows into a deadly war for power and the heart. Watch now!

title: Clumsy Love [Hindi]
description: Clumsy Love

title: Crorepati ki Contract Wife
description: When fiery Maya Sinha crosses paths with ruthless billionaire lawyer Sameer Malhotra, sparks fly. Between betrayal by her ex Raj and her fight to save her father, Maya discovers that the cold-hearted tycoon’s guarded heart may just belong to her. Watch Now!

title: Mai Jhoota Tu Jhooti
description: Two childhood lovers reunite and rush into marriage, believing they’ve found love beyond money. But there’s a twist—both are secretly billionaires, pretending to be poor. As lies pile up, their relationship is tested by ego, humiliation, and hidden truths. When reality finally hits, will their love survive the biggest secret of all… or shatter forever?

title: Baazigar O Baazigar
description: A rising rockstar believes he achieved fame through his own talent until the woman who silently built his career walks out of his life, forcing him to confront the truth about love, ambition, and the cost of betrayal.

title: Sorry! Not a Gold Digger
description: When hardworking delivery girl Tara crosses paths with billionaire heir Rohan Mehta through a twist of fate, their unexpected flash marriage sparks a journey filled with secrets, clashes, and unspoken love. As Tara struggles to protect her dignity and dreams, and Rohan hides his true identity, will this unlikely union blossom into real love or collapse under lies and pride? Watch Now!

title: Billionaire Bana Fake boyfriend [Hindi]
description: A billionaire disguises himself as a beggar to find true love and ends up in a fake relationship with a wealthy heiress, who’s being forced by her family to marry a spoiled billionaire.

title: The Hidden Waris
description: A self-made tycoon, Deep Shah, hides his roots as the son of a humble security guard. When his father arrives in Mumbai, he’s brutally humiliated by the same elite world Deep now rules. As truth unravels, power flips—exposing class arrogance, testing loyalty, and setting the stage for a ruthless reckoning.

title: CEO's Magical Bodyguard
description: Chirag Chauhan lives as an ordinary man, hiding the truth that he is the last disciple of the legendary yogi Neeldev. When he saves Nimisha, the fearless chairperson of the Nandini Group, destiny places him as her personal bodyguard. Between power struggles, betrayal, a forced contract marriage, and rising enemies, Chirag must protect Nimisha while keeping his divine identity secret until fate forces him to reveal his true strength.

title: Commando Panther
description: A decorated special forces commander, living incognito as a mechanic to escape his traumatic past, finds his secret life upended when he falls for a powerful CEO, forcing him to confront old enemies, a web of corporate conspiracies, and his own guilt to protect his new love and reclaim his destiny. Watch now.

title: Billionaire Bhikari [Hindi]
description: Aryan lives like a beggar—but hides a billionaire legacy. When Jhanvi insults him, she unknowingly steps into the world of a man who owns more than she can imagine. Billionaire Bhikari is a fiery tale of secrets, ego clashes, and a love story born where judgment ends. Watch Now!

title: Nakli Pati Nikla Crorepati [Hindi]
description: Lakshya Oberoi—India’s youngest billionaire—was never meant to be anyone’s husband. But a one-night stand with fiery Tanya Goenka traps him in a dangerous contract marriage built on lies, lust, and survival. As Tanya battles her scheming stepmother, jealous stepsister and ruthless ex-fiancé, secrets unravel and enemies close in. In a world of stolen identities and deadly conspiracies, Lakshya must decide if Tanya is his greatest weakness—or the only ally who can save him.

title: The Hidden Boss
description: A billionaire CEO, Manav, secretly fakes his own downfall to trap his rival, Karan. On his wedding day, he’s publicly humiliated as “bankrupt,” and his new wife Ritika’s family turns against him. Despite insults and betrayal, Manav silently endures, hiding the truth as he tests love, loyalty, and prepares a powerful comeback.

title: Aa Nimisham
description:
A young man’s life changes forever after a tragic accident draws him into a mysterious household. As secrets, lies, and hidden motives unfold, he must confront love, betrayal, and his own haunted past.
Aa Nimisham is an emotional thriller where every moment holds a revelation — and nothing is as it seems.

title: Secret Legend [Hindi]
description: When humble masseur Veer Jindal is humiliated by his wife Simran and her family, they have no idea he is secretly the billionaire chairman of the powerful Choksi Group. As betrayals unfold and family ties are tested, Veer’s hidden identity shakes their world, exposing greed, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Watch Now!

title: Royal Betrayal [Hindi]
description: In the chaos of a deadly warzone, a woman crosses paths with the royal heir who shattered her heart — now forced to trust him for survival. As danger closes in, love and revenge collide in a race against death.

title: Brother Betrayal
description: Alok Upadhyay, a noble elder brother, sacrifices everything to secure a bright future for his younger brother Rohan. But as Alok rises to power with the support of his devoted wife Anita and strong-willed daughter Aditi, Rohan, twisted by greed and fueled by his arrogant wife Diya, betrays the very family that gave him everything. A tale of sacrifice, ambition, and the tragic downfall of brotherhood.

title: The Ultimate Return
description: The Ultimate Return is a high-octane power drama where a man written off as a loser is revealed as Leo—the unseen kingmaker controlling billion-dollar empires. As ruthless heirs, corrupt elites, and broken relationships collide, love, ambition, and revenge play out in a brutal succession battle where power bows only to truth and courage.

title: The Billionaire Servant
description: “A humble, soft-spoken man is brutally wronged by powerful enemies, forcing him to shed his innocence and rise as a fearless force of justice. As Ram transforms into Avtar, he challenges corruption, family betrayal, and social cruelty—becoming the protector the helpless prayed for.”

title: Gun, Gangster Aur Good Boy
description:
Mafia Girl is a high-voltage romantic crime drama with dark humor and emotional depth.
Mayra, who rules the underworld with fear, experiences love for the first time—with a man who has nothing but honesty.
Sunny, always exploited and underestimated, finally becomes someone worth fighting for.
The show explores class divide, toxic love, power politics, and emotional manipulation.
Every episode blends romance, danger, and drama with shocking twists.
At its heart, it asks—can love survive when it is born in violence?

title: The Billionaire Returns Home
description: Riyansh Singhaniya, a billionaire CEO travels to a small town to buy land for his first mall—only to discover that an old, struggling couple refusing to sell may actually be his long-lost parents. Going undercover as a common man, he witnesses their poverty, humiliation, and the cruelty of their greedy relatives.

title: Second Class Billionaire
description: In a single day, aboard a train heading back to his village, billionaire Rajat Mhatre’s worlds collide—his hidden identity, his forgotten family, and the ruthless man who tormented them. What begins as a journey home turns into a battle for dignity, justice, and truth. As the village celebrates a grand resort project led by the arrogant Nitin, they are unaware that the real power - “The Silver Lord” - has arrived to reclaim everything that was once stripped from him.

title: Secretary Rosie [Tamil]
description: She wasn’t just a secretary. She was temptation wrapped in silk, whispering promises that blurred the line between loyalty and lust. With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

title: Study God [Tamil]
description: నింగ్ షియావో ఒక బాహ్య దేవుడి ఆత్మ యొక్క శకలాన్ని వెంబడిస్తూ మానవ లోకానికి చేరుకుంటాడు. జోంగ్ క్వింగ్‌ను రక్షించి, ఆమె కుటుంబానికి సహాయం చేస్తాడు. బాయి కుటుంబం మరియు అతని మునుపటి నిశ్చితార్థి బాయి జిక్యూయు ఆయనను తప్పుగా అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు. కానీ, వారి వర్గాలలో ఉన్న ఒక ద్రోహిని బయటపడతాడు. బాహ్య దేవుడిని సంహరించిన తర్వాత, బాయి కుటుంబం ఆయన అసలు మహత్వాన్ని గ్రహించి, గతంలో చూపించిన అవమానానికి పశ్చాత్తాపం వ్యక్తం చేస్తుంది.

title: Keshav: Child King Returns
description: A thousand year old prince awakens in the body of a modern six year old boy. No one knows whether it is destiny or part of a hidden conspiracy. But within a powerful family filled with dark power struggles, the child’s sharp intelligence begins to shake everyone. Now the question is can a child change the fate of an entire family?

title: Kodiguddu VS Koteeswarudu
description: Mahesh sustains his livelihood by selling eggs. Meanwhile, Vidya, a widow, works as a delivery executive. The narrative explores the unforeseen turns their lives take and the direction in which their journeys ultimately unfold.

title: Journey Back Home
description: At thirty, Krishna begins a journey to his hometown after learning about the tragic loss of his father, wife, and daughter in a flood. Along the way, he meets Rahul, a mysterious man who changes his life forever. This is not just a journey — it’s a search for love, trust, and lost relationships.

title: Rented Husband [Telugu]
description: Rented Husband

title: Secretary Rosie [Telugu]
description: She wasn’t just a secretary. She was temptation wrapped in silk, whispering promises that blurred the line between loyalty and lust. With every calculated smile, every lingering touch, she stepped deeper into his marriage—turning boardroom meetings into battles of desire, and home into a war zone. But how far would she go? To steal his property? To wear his wife’s crown? Or to seduce her way into a future where his empire bore her name alone?

title: The Call Boy I Met in Hyderabad [Telugu]
description: A girl accidentally meets call boy Vishal and ends up marrying him. She’s the heir to millions, but why did she marry a call boy? Find out in "The Call Boy I Met in Hyderabad" only on Kuku TV

title: Final Bliss [Kannada]
description: When billionaire industrialist Hardeep Singh Oberoi tries to shield his daughter Mahima from heartbreak, she launches “Mission Daddy Ki Dulhan” to find him a bride. Fate brings them to the warm-hearted Srikavita Nair, whose simple values clash yet connect with Hardeep’s guarded world. But as secrets of Srikavita’s past and her abusive ex-husband Rajeev Menon surface, relationships are tested, identities are shaken, and love, trust, and family bonds must stand the ultimate test. Watch Now!

title: Fire Force [Hindi]
description: A superhuman firefighter force is formed to deal with supernatural fire incidents.

title: Reborn to Master the Blade: From Hero-King to Extraordinary Squire [Hindi]
description: From his deathbed, Hero-King Inglis, the divine knight and master of all he surveys, gazes down on the empire he built with his mighty hand. Having devoted his life to statecraft and his subjects' well-being, his one unfulfilled wish is to live again, for himself this time: a warrior's life he'd devoted himself to before his rise to power. His patron goddess, Alistia, hears his plea and smiles upon him, flinging his soul into the far future. Goddesses work in mysterious ways, so not only is Inglis now the daughter of a minor noble family, but at her first coming-of-age ceremony at 6, she's found ineligible to begin her knighthood. However, for a lady of Inglis's ambition, this is less a setback and more the challenge she was (re)born to overcome. "It's not the blood that runs through your veins that makes a knight; it's the blood you shed on the battlefield". The curtain rises on the legend of an extraordinary lady squire reborn to master the blade.

title: A Prince in a Pawnshop
description: David Solomon, a wealthy banker, is merciless in his dealings with his rich clients, from whom he exacts the highest interest. He aids the poor as much as possible. To facilitate his kindness among the people of the Ghetto, he runs there a pawnshop, unlike all others, for to the needy he measures out money, not according to the value of the articles they offer, but according to their needs. David's son, Maurice, is given to high living. It grieves his father, who is, however, consoled by the fact that his daughter, Ethel, seconds her father's charities by maintaining a day nursery for the children of the poor. One day David sees a young girl fall unconscious in the street. He takes her to the hospital where the doctor tells him that the girl, Mary, is suffering from exhaustion. David's heart is touched and he resolves to make Mary's future his own care. When she has regained her strength he finds her a position as a model in a dress house of a friend, Silver. Ethel visits the dress house to buy gowns, bringing Maurice with her. He sees Mary for the second time, having noticed her upon the street. Maurice arranges to meet Mary under an assumed name, and pursues his courtship with all seeming love. She so learns to worship Maurice that she gives him all, not stopping to count the cost, nor to demand the wedding ring. For a brief while Mary tastes of a great happiness, but Stevins, the man for whom she once worked, and who, because she would not encourage his advances, drove her from every honest position, naming her as a thief, visits the dress house to get gowns for "The Bunch of Flowers," a set of girls so termed by Maurice who has been much in their company. He recognizes Mary, repeats the accusation, and her employer discharges her. Mary returns to the little flat supported by Maurice, where she tells her story. Maurice has begun to tire of her. He seeks Stevins, who tells a seemingly truthful story. Maurice believes it and leaves Mary, writing to this effect. He, however, does not know that the girl he has wronged is about to become a mother. Six years elapse, and we find Mary and her little son, living in poverty. Again she is rescued by David Soloman, who has called to see a deserving case next door to Mary, the object of his charity being Mrs. Payne, the landlady who drove Mary from her door, and who is now a paralytic. title: A Burglar for a Night
description: In Hong Kong, William Neal helps Kirk Marden fight off a group of rowdies. Back in New York, Kirk again turns to William's assistance when his father's rivals plot to take control of the Marden railroad. William teaches Kirk how to open safes so that Kirk can procure papers outlining the takeover plans. While Kirk is robbing the safe, Janet Leslie, daughter of one of the conspirators, enters, and Kirk forces her to marry him so that she cannot testify against him. Kirk succeeds in reconciling his father with his rivals and in winning his new wife's love.

title: A Day at a Time
description: Alba and Anastasia are twins with cerebral palsy who touched the heart of President Clinton with their plea for equal access. They come from an extraordinary family where everyone is determined the twins will be included in all activities. The fact that they are both in wheelchairs does not keep them from school, summer camp, or church. Their mother, Mary, thinks nothing of carrying them up and down several flights of stairs in their wheelchairs. She is a woman in constant motion, bathing, dressing, feeding and taking pleasure in seeing the twins are attractively dressed. She uses her tenacity and charm to assure that her children receive all the medical and educational benefits to which they are entitled. The filmmakers became close to the family, capturing the milestones of their lives: a birthday party, days at summer camp, their joyous first communion in church. Filmed over a period of four years, this unforgettable story will inspire everyone concerned with the challenges of family life and the place of disabled children in our society.

title: A Kingdom for a Crown
description: The Royal Family is a beloved, yet controversial staple of the United Kingdom. From the beloved Queen, to Prince Harry and Meghan choosing to live in another country, to the acrimonious divorce of Charles and Diana, to Prince Andrew's sex scandal, this cheeky documentary covers it all.

title: A Day in a Life
description: Paris. Gabrielle and Enzo, two teenagers from the same gang, meet in front of the school. Cigarettes, the affirmation of sexual desire and the discovery of new drugs punctuate their day. Each one, in his own way, celebrates or laments childhood that is slipping away.

title: A Year in a Village
description: The documentary A Year in a Village features a village in Moravia, Czech Republic. The focus is on 12-year-old Vojta and his father Danek, who are both into beekeeping and on Vojta's 16-year-old cousin Anetka, who is preparing for her first participation in "hody" celebration, and of their grandmother Bohuska. title: A New Life with a Jackpot

title: A tanyagondnok
description: The farmsteads of the Great Plain are the treasures of European settlement history. The question is how long they will stay. It is a fact that in Hungary the farm world has been dying for decades. More than one-third of the farms in the Great Plain are elderly, often incapacitated, completely isolated from the outside world. Their living conditions are often worse than those of people living in distant, exotic Third World countries. All this in 2014, in the heart of Europe. The survival of the farm world, and often the survival of the people living there, would be almost impossible without the various custodial services and their charismatic staff that have been operating in Hungary for more than twenty years and supplying the people living on the farms with virtually everything they need. Our film presents the often heroic daily lives of these dedicated people, while providing a comprehensive picture of the 21st-century Hungarian homeland and the lives of those living there, which is increasingly becoming a tragic memento of a sinking world. One of the hundreds of caretakers in Hungary is Márta Farkas. Through the activities of a caretaker, we show the last living witnesses and representatives of the lives and struggles of survivors of everyday life in the Great Plain and the struggle for survival in everyday life and a disappearing lifestyle and peasant culture.

To challenge fate, he also declares that he'll travel into the future. The day he has to make good on his promises, all "Nordestina" is there, expecting Antonio to realize his promises.

title: A Crime
description: A young man,Frédéric,is accused of a double murder :his own parents .Thanks to his brilliant lawyer,Maître Dunand ,he is acquitted .But ,shortly afterwards, the arrogant boy tells his counsel that he was actually guilty.Does he tell the truth or does he lie? In Frédéric's luxury mansion in Lyon town ,begins a long night during which terrible secrets are revealed .

title: Pick A Little, Talk A Little
description: A pandemic-induced talk show covering all things theatre and theatre related topics.

title: Sydney: A Story of a City
description: Virginia, a young and adventurous woman, travels from England to Sydney, Australia, in search of her Australian ancestors.

title: ¡¡¡A tope!!!
description: In 1980s Madrid, while the most prominent bands in the music scene perform in fashion clubs, a couple of teenagers, Juanjo and Raquel, jeopardize their sentimental relationship when Juanjo gets involved with another classmate from high school called Marta.

title: A Parceira Dele, A Vingança Dela
description: Na véspera de seu casamento arranjado, Ava Russell é dopada por seu noivo, Nico Moretti, e tem o cabelo brutalmente raspado por sua comparsa, Scarlett. Recusando-se a engolir essa humilhação, Ava contata secretamente Damian Costello, o poderoso herdeiro da família Costello, que a ama em segredo há doze anos. No dia do casamento, quando Nico tenta colocar Ava em sua família às escondidas através de uma cerimônia medíocre e oculta, e Scarlett arranca publicamente sua peruca para zombar dela, Damian chega com uma frota magnífica para se casar com Ava em grande estilo. Com a ajuda de Damian e da Comissão, Nico e Scarlett perdem seu poder e são presos por violarem as leis da família, enquanto Ava finalmente encontra seu verdadeiro protetor e a felicidade.

title: A Promise
description: A romantic drama set in Germany just before WWI and centered on a married woman who falls in love with her husband's protégé. Separated first by duties and then by the war, they pledge their devotion to one another.

title: Ivin A.
description: Private Internal Troops Andrei Ivin is a security guard in a strict regime zone. He is absolutely not adapted to military service, a typical humanist who left the historical and archival institute. One summer, he stands at night on duty on the tower. A recidivist nicknamed Mishka Knyaz escapes. Private Ivin could not shoot him, and he was forced to go under the tribunal himself. In an explanatory note, he writes that he "refuses to continue to dispose of someone else's life." Under the supervision of the company commander Narotiev, he is sent to the disbat. Senior Lieutenant Narotiev is almost the same age as Ivin. It's hard for him to believe that the private is telling the truth. In his opinion, the soldier was simply at a loss, giving evidence, and fell asleep at the post, or, perhaps, chickened out.

title: A Wednesday

title: What's a Podcast? A Documentary Film
description: Podcasting is the new Punk Rock! Podcasting saved my life. What IS a Podcast? Podcasting is a new digital communications medium that is not only changing the way people consume media, it is changing peoples lives. Through my journey, I have met fellow podcasters, and listeners, whom I now call friends. The inspiration and comfort this medium gives to so many is a story that hasn't yet received the attention it deserves. In 2009 things went crazy for me and my family. We were living in Virginia when I was downsized, leaving us with a mortgage and a feeling of What now? Times were tough. No one was hiring. This downward spiral lasted for a few years, forcing us to return home to New Jersey to live with relatives. I was in a deep, dark depression. At my lowest, I picked up a book from the famous movie director and podcast pioneer, Kevin Smith. The book gave me permission to do something crazy, if not desperate. Do it Start a podcast Go talk on the internet with your friends. And so I did, starting my own highly successful podcast: ThatMan on Fatman. But this film is not just about my journey. Its the journey of the many podcasters, and listeners, friends and family, and how this medium is changing, helping, and even saving peoples lives, let alone building communities. The world is now at everyone's fingertips and podcasters are the pioneers of a new digital age and medium. Please join me in this insider look of a world heading for tomorrow.

title: Ultra B
description: There is a little baby in the town who has incredible powers. He use these powers to help his brothers who know about it but he also uses these powers as naughty boy and he not shows his powers anybody else .

title: Plan B
description: The story of a man with a military background, Ivan Malan, and his partner, Paul Schmidt, who plan and carry out a theft from a gang boss. The prize is the Flame Girl - a painting by the master painter Vermeer that is worth EUR30 million.

title: Ivelisse vs Izzy B
description: Kelsey Raegan wears the stripes and you can tell from the introductions that she may not be impartial here. Ivelisse eats youngsters like Izzy for snacks, but Izzy challenges her to a most knockouts within the time limit rules match. Ivelisse comes out blasting with roundhouse kicks, turnbuckle smashes and face slams. She mounts Izzy for a straitjacket choke that quickly secures the first knockout. Izzy took her lumps but learned her lessons and after a back and forth fight she uses the same hold to kayo the veteran! Ivelisse is livid, but Kelsey is thrilled and the battle continues. Ivelisse takes the fight to Izzy, putting her out with a choking facelock and back mounted Camel Clutch, but each time Izzy manages to mimic her opponent’s offense and knocks Ivelisse out using her own holds. Tied in falls and with time ticking down, the pair brawl for control. Ivelisse nails the lanky blonde with kicks, stomps and chokes before driving her face first into the turnbuckles. Can Ivelisse put the youngster down once more to secure the win, or will Izzy prove herself against the veteran…and will Kelsey stay out of the fight?

title: Vitamine C
description: -'VITAMINE C' is a documentary series (10 episodes of 22 minutes each, broadcast on ICI Radio-Canada Télé), highlighting initiatives in the Ottawa-Gatineau region (in Canada) to improve the health and quality of life of the people who live there. Hosted by athlete Caroline Calvé, "Vitamine C" presents inspiring stories from people in the greater National Capital Region who have decided to get involved in improving the quality of life and health of their fellow citizens. The topics covered are autism, malnutrition, suicide, violence against women, animal therapy, overweight, physical activity, blood and plasma donation, as well as art therapy.

title: Wadd: The Life & Times of John C. Holmes
description: Friends, enemies, acquaintances, and family of porn star John Holmes recall their experiences with him, from his childhood to his eventual death from AIDS in 1988.

title: Sky C.
description: Sofia (AKA Sky) is a single mom supporting her daughter and her father. Growing up in the gym watching her father train to become a professional boxer her passion has always been to become a MMA pro-fighter. Her father's dream was cut short in the fight that would make him a professional boxer, when he sustained a spinal injury confining him to a wheelchair. Now her father is adamantly against Sky having any part of fighting for fear of her succumbing to the same fate he endures. But Sky passion for fighting could not be extinguished, so she continued to train in between working, being a mother and caretaker. After losing her main source of income, financial struggles ensue that forces her to secretly take underground fights to make money to support her family. One night she knocks out an opponent and it turns out to be the current MMA champion. The crowd has it all on video and the footage goes viral causing the MMA champion to challenge her to a real match that proves that Sky's knockout was just lucky. The viral footage gets back to her father and he further finds that his best friend was part of her training. The father confronts them both and the argument reveals the truth of why he didn't want Sky to fight. Sky leaves with her daughter and begins training for the fight of her life, without her father, until the day of the fight.

title: Reborn
description: Qingyu Qiao's family relocates after her sister's death. Seeking truth, Qingyu creates tensions but persists with friend Sheng Ming's support. She reconciles with family, excels academically, and attends her dream university.

description: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Somehow Married to the CEO
description:
Yulia Sanders and Marcus Xavier were a in love couple. Ever since the Sanders family went bankrupt, Yulia dropped out of university to work as a janitor, while Marcus started searching for a new girlfriend. Five years later, Yulia awaited Marcus to marry her, only to discover that Marcus had cheated on her.
Yulia planned to confront Marcus. But unexpectedly, she saved Troy Flair, and immediately entered into a marriage. Yulia remained unaware of Troy's true identity. Yvette schemed to frame Yulia, but Troy intervened in time.
Fearing exposure to her misdeeds, Yvette humiliated Yulia and Troy. At that moment, Troy's grandfather, revealed Troy as the CEO of Flair Group.

title: More of Me
description: Alice is a burnt out. She tries to keep her kids in order, her husband happy, and runs a cause of trying to save a tree she loves. One day when looking in her three way mirror, she wishes there was more of her. All of a sudden, the three reflections of Alice pop out of the mirror. One version is motherly and takes care of her kids, the second one works on the cause that Alice is fighting, and the final version of Alice is oversexed and just wants to please Alice's husband, Rex. The trade off is that the real Alice becomes invisible. At first, Alice enjoys her peace and quiet, but when her alter egos start running amok and start doing things she doesn't like, Alice vows to take her life back.

title: The CEO's Secret Wife
description: Emily marries Michael for her grandmother's medical costs. Sarah steals Emily's jade pendant and impersonates Michael's life-saver from three years ago. Though promising Sarah everything, Michael falls for Emily. When truth emerges, he pursues Emily.

title: The Split

title: Against the sky Supreme
description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. The outer universe is ruled by demons, and the inner universe is divided into The Realm of gods, the Eternal Realm, and the Mortal Realm. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. In the field of Jiutian Xin, nine immortal emperors commanded all star fields in nine layers. Above the nine heavens is the realm of purification of immortal gods.

title: Assassin
description: A former government operative is called out of retirement to battle a new super weapon gone bad, a cyborg. Reluctantly, the retired operative trails the cyborg and tries to destroy it.

title: Miss Lucky Go!
description: Aspiring figurine designer Chen Miran enrolls in university for a fresh start but ends up in the same class as her ex, Zhong Weiqiong, who once dumped her coldly. Determined to win her back, Zhong schemes to reignite their love, unaware their past breakup was a misunderstanding. As old feelings resurface and they reconcile, a surprising rival appears, threatening to unravel their newfound happiness.

title: The Ace Pilot Who Saved the Skies（DUBBED）
description: Tycoon Graham Carter secretly boarded an economy flight to throw off rivals, while Ethan Miles was requested to captain the flight through severe thunderstorms. However, an arrogant female pilot forced Ethan out of the cockpit and took command. When the plane plunged into a massive thunderstorm, threatening everyone's lives, Ethan stepped up to turn the tide and save all onboard.

title: After Everything
description: Can love survive betrayal and heartbreak? 💔 A journey of pain, loss, and love that refuses to fade.

title: O hrysos tis Argolidas - Agapi kai ponos gia to portokali
Rules Were Never Her Thing (DUBBED)
description: After ten years of suffering with the Lowe family, May Lowe finally glimpses hope when she meets Max Dow. Initially, she sees him only as a means to escape her family's virtual prison, but as time passes, she finds herself falling for him. His unwavering trust and devotion slowly break down her walls. Though their bond begins with deception, it ultimately leads them toward salvation and healing, their souls bound together on the path to recovery.

title: Outside In: Getting Lost and Found in Alaska
description: A photographer/cinematographer in an emotional rut travels from Austin to Alaska to get lost in the beauty of nature, and in the process, finds himself again.

title: Got Dumped. Got LadyAid.(English-dubbed)
description: A broke delivery guy, Gavin, is dumped by his girlfriend the day she graduates for a rich man. Humiliated, he activates the LadyAid Cash-back System: help a woman, get huge cash. A small favor earns $78K. Soon, he's saving women from debt and disaster, rising from zero to mansions, a restaurant empire, and a law firm. His ex fights back with lies and schemes, but every woman he helped has his back. She ends up in jail. Gavin walks away with Paige's heart, a fortune, and no regrets.

title: Lighter & Princess [Hindi]
description: Zhu Yun's college life has just begun, but is disrupted by the arrival of the bad boy, Li Xun, who turns her world upside down.

title: Universal Babe
description: UNIVERSAL BABE is a groundbreaking documentary about the baseball legend Babe Ruth. The film uncovers little known facts about the Babe's social consciousness and battle with major league baseball throughout his career.

title: [Doublé] Renaître et devenir une légende
description: Poussé à l'autodestruction par les Trois Seigneurs Suprêmes, Carson, héritier de la Lignée Impériale Ascendante, renaît à 20 ans. Avec Victor Yates, il se venge de son ex et du Grand Maître Cyrus, devenant le maître redouté de Newhaven, prêt à reprendre sa place au sommet.

title: Creating Points of Importance
description: In late 2006, Ryan Gerstenbuhler, a university student living with spastic cerebral palsy, wrote a proposal for a visual arts endeavor with himself as the undraped subject. The project was envisioned as a respectable, but provocative, visual presentation offering the public an intimate view of a person living with a physical disability. Stemming from a series of life-drawing sessions, the project was realized by a group of artists working in paint, illustration, collage and sculpture. This film is a document of the discussion and work in the last months leading up to the exhibition opening.

title: Lovely Us
description: In the summer of 2007, exactly one year before the opening ceremony of the Beijing Olympic Games, the family members of the Shude faculty could finally move together and say goodbye to the tube-shaped apartments which were loaded with their sweet memories like a symphony of cooking utensils. They were going to move into the brand-new and unfamiliar residential quarters with their new hopes. And a series of things about growing up, dreams and affections happened among Huang Chengzi, Tan Song, Zhu Jinxiao, Chen Zui and He Jinzhao would become the sweetest marks of the Shude faculty quarters.

title: Stupid Movie of the Week
description: "Videobob's Stupid Movie Of The Week" is hosted by comic "Videobob", who walks the viewers through some of the worst movies ever made. Some of the movies are older black and white monster camp, and others are more current independent features. This classic format has been used by others such as "Elvira" and others.

title: The Lost Tomb 2
description: Second volume of the first physical book "Tomb Notes: Seven Stars Lu Wang Palace" in the series of Tomb Notes. It mainly tells three things. First, Wu Xie got a snake-brown copper fish and launched an investigation around it. The second point is that Wu Xie Sanshu followed the Wenjin archaeological team's strange experience in Xisha, causing Wu Xie and others to be curious. The third point, Wu Xie and others entered the Xisha Wangzang sea wrecked seabed tomb, and found many horrifying events, including human face scorpion, sea monkey and other mysterious creatures.

title: For Love and Nothing Less (DUBBED)
description: Seven years ago, Luna Sawyer was pregnant when she discovered that her boyfriend, Samuel Payne—who was battling cancer—was secretly the heir to Payne Corp in Reydon. Samuel was offered a deal: if he broke up with Luna, they would pay for his treatment. But deeply in love with her, he rejected the offer, unaware that Luna had overheard the conversation. Determined not to hold Samuel back, Luna silently chose to leave—only to be presumed dead in a car accident.

title: WMF Medium Rare!

title: The Wolfless Carpenter Rules the World 2
description: The Wolfless Carpenter Rules the World 2

title: Destined for You
description: To stop her mother's nagging, Violet Evans rushes into a whirlwind marriage with a stranger, Tristan Sinclair. She assumes he is a regular assistant, unaware his true identity is The wealthiest man in Harbor City. They fall deeply in love, but her jealous friend Kendra Brooks teams up with her ex, Spencer Crawford, to frame Violet with AI deepfakes and orchestrate a car crash. Protecting Violet, Tristan is severely injured and loses his memory—forgetting only her. His mother then arranges for him to marry his childhood friend, Blair Kensington. Violet never gives up. Eventually, Tristan regains his memories, exposes the plot, and they hold a grand wedding where he tells the world: She is the woman I married.

title: (Dubbed) A Scorned Queen’s Retribution
description: (Dubbed) A Scorned Queen’s Retribution

title: They Called Her a Curse, He Gave Her a Home
description: Mocked as a "curse" for foreseeing disasters, little Mia Carter is abused by her foster family. Billionaire Hayden Foster saves her, then adopts her after she saves his life. Her gift protects her new family through crisis after crisis — until the truth reveals she's the lost heiress they've searched for for ten years.

title: Distortion
description: This was Studio Moonchalk's feature-length (more than 40 minutes to make it feature) animated film debut using the RPG Maker MV engine as an experiment, non-narrative piece. Set in a fantasy world about the thirty places (15 insides and outsides) became distorted into minimalist colors after everyone else left without a trace.

title: The Legend of Anle
description: Ten years ago, Ziyuan's family was wiped out. To uncover the truth of how the current imperial family had ascended to the throne, she entered the imperial court under the name of Ren Anle and became acquainted with Hanye.

title: Invincible
description: A man is eating stir-fried noodles by the roadside when a group of thugs approach him menacingly. It turns out that not long ago, Han Yuxuan destroyed a stronghold of the Black Dragon Society. The lead thug, recognizing the man as the pathetic husband of the Lin Group's CEO, mocks him for not understanding his place. As the bully swings a baseball bat at the man, it is effortlessly blocked with one hand, and the man grabs the thug's vital point, warning him that if this were three years ago, he would already be a corpse. While the man is dealing with the thugs, a luxury car arrives, and the passenger is his fiancée. However, her subordinates continue to ridicule the man, saying he's not worthy of the war goddess fiancée, unaware that the man's true identity is that of the supreme and invincible Wu Anjun...

title: Demon Lord Wants My Heart
description: Lily, a fairy obsessed with romance tales, buys a love trial with spirit stones. She meets Demon Lord Lucas, who covets her heart. She adores him, while Lucas, enduring deadly poison, grows to love her. But she soon learns he is a world-destroying demon who has always intended to kill her.

title: Fuyao
description: Meng Fu Yao, a woman born from a divine lotus petal. She journeys towards the heavens in search of a secret order and to reveal a conspiracy originating from the heavens. In the process, she falls in love with the crown prince.

title: Reborn as My Enemy's Bride
description: On her wedding eve, Lin Zhixia is murdered by her sister, but a 19th-century spirit slips into her body and revives her. She plots carefully, dismantles every trap, and catches Fu Cheng's eye. Together, they crack schemes, clear her father's name, claim the Fu empire, and she becomes a top designer.

title: Marry Me Again
description: An heiress who lost her almost-husband on the day of their wedding meets a mysterious guy who looks exactly like him. Their paths keep crossing in the high stakes world of conglomerates.

title: Sniper Butterfly [Hindi]
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: Martial World Leader
description: Ling Yun, the young master of the Founding Duke's family, is framed by the treacherous court official Cao Zhengchun, leading to the execution of his entire family. With the help of his loyal brother Ye Feng, Ling Yun narrowly escapes death, but Ye Feng is killed by Cao Zhengchun. On the brink of death, Ling Yun is reborn and begins to steadily grow stronger. When he finally becomes the leader of the martial world and prepares to avenge Ye Feng, he unexpectedly dies again, only to be reborn once more in his youth. This time, he is determined to protect Ye Feng and his family.

title: The Wanted Detective
description: On his wedding day, elite detective Xiao Beiming is framed for murder and treason. Years later, he returns and teams up with allies to uncover a sinister conspiracy while clearing his name.

title: My Five Incredible Sisters
description: After being dumped by his accomplished girlfriend, Fabian Quinn, a modest fishmonger, stumbles upon a life-altering revelation—he has five extraordinary sisters. His eldest sister reigns as the billionaire president of Quinn Holdings, the second is a globally adored actress, the third leads the world's deadliest assassin organization, the fourth holds a formidable position as a general of Celestia, and the fifth is a renowned doctor. As his remorseful ex-girlfriend belatedly realizes the gravity of her mistake, she remains oblivious to the fact that Fabian's true identity far surpasses the remarkable achievements of his five exceptional sisters.

title: Soul Land 2: The Peerless Tang Clan [English]
description: Storyline about the daughter of Tang San and Xiao Wu. 10,000 years after Soul Land 1, a world where magic and machinery co-exist Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong meet at Shrek Academy.

title: The Love You Give Me [Hindi]
description:
Five years ago, a young woman named Min Hui accidentally fell for a young man named Xin Qi. But things between them were complicated because Min Hui was pretending to be Xin Qi's long lost childhood friend in a misguided way to help the friend who had died suddenly. Furthermore, Xin Qi suffered from a dangerous and potentially life-threatening heart condition, and Min Hui now desperately in love, didn't want to see him suffer. It didn't help matters that each time she tried to tell him the truth, he would cut her off, not believe her, or his heart condition would relapse. When he finally learned the entire truth, he cut all ties with her.

Now, five years later, they are reunited at a business event in the most uncomfortable of situations. Min Hui has risen to become an R&D assistant to one of the directors at a tech firm and Xin Qi has also made a name for himself as the CEO of an investment firm. Deciding that "fate" has brought them back into contact for a reason, Xin Qi decides to take all of his previous anger and betrayal out on Min Hui. But "fate" also reveals that Min Hui has a son, who is suffering from the same exact heart condition as Xin Qi making him realize through a series of events that he's the father--much to the adorable boy's delight! After some heart to heart conversations, explanations, and even a quirky living arrangement, can these two forgive each other and themselves for the mistakes they both made in the past and rekindle their love, now as a fully evolved family?

(Source: Viki; edited by MyDramaList)

title: Unmasking My Flash Marriage Husband's Disguise
description: After the divorce, Ella Blaine's ex-husband, John Jones, asked, "We were married for a year. Did you ever love me?""No!" Ella replied, walking away without a hint of hesitation.Later, a manipulative friend revealed a pregnancy involving John's child. Ella responded by exposing his infertility secret.Years later, when questioned about Ella's decision to marry the seemingly perfect Zac Smith, Ella, with unwavering confidence, declares, "If I can't be his bride, I'll be his new mother. Will he dare not to marry?"

title: My Billionaire Husband in Disguise
description:
Yvonne is the Quinns' adopted daughter. Sarah Quinn snatched Yvonne’s boyfriend and also teamed up with her parents, using underhanded tactics to force Yvonne to take her place in marrying the Joneses’ incapable son, Stanley Jones. 
Though dissatisfied and furious about the marriage alliance, Stanley was powerless to oppose his family’s decision. So, he used another extreme method to fight his marriage—pretending to be a poor and jobless man.

title: Our Secret [Hindi]
description: Two high schoolers start out antagonistic but begrudgingly become closer. The story spans through years and shows the growth of them as individuals and the and the effects this has on their relationship with each other.

title: SSS-Rank Talent: The Nerd Mage Incoming
description: SSS-Rank Talent: The Nerd Mage Incoming

title: The Journey of Flower
description: It is a love story between a master and his disciple. The main character Hua Qiangu is an unlucky orphan who's looking for a chance to learn magic and martial arts to survive after her parents died. Appreciating her hard working nature and kind heart, and predicting her tragic destiny, she enters Chang Liu, an immortal sect, to seek peace and solutions. Bai Zihua, the sect leader of Chang Liu, takes her as his only disciple. Qian Gu falls in love with her teacher but doesn't reveal her true feelings until the end. Eventually, the truth has been revealed that she was born as Nü Wa's descendant and has access to godly power.She summoned the Demon God to save her master and the God transferred all his power into her body afterwards, therefore, making her the new ruler of the demons. Although Zihua tries to protect her and change her fate, Qiangu is constantly tortured by the machinations of those who wish to see her dead.

title: Tu e Eu
description: Two sisters, São and Daniela are volleyball players, one night they go to a party where São is rapped by Alexandre, they tell what happened to her mother Lurdes.

title: Fratella e sorello
description: Serpente is a model and Giocondo is a rich middle-class man. For a trivial misunderstanding, the two end up in prison one day and there they spend a lot of time and become friends.

title: E! News
description: Airing weeknights at 7pm CST, E!'s hosts and correspondents keep you in the know with the hottest entertainment stories, trends and celebrity interviews; plus discussions each day about the latest developments and yet-to-be-confirmed gossip. Fun and topical, this is E! News.

title: Vakil-e avval
description: Iran is still reeling from the ravages of the First World war. Two elderly sibling princes decide to run for the newly founded national-assembly, in an effort to dissuade its members from voting to end Qajar rule.

title: Salat-e zohr
description: When Soori's brothers kill a man who was bothering her and get incarcerated, they trust in Kaka Mostafa to keep their sister safe. One night someone enters Mostafa's house and rapes Soori without showing his face. Next day everybody seeks the truth and blames Karim, Mostafa's dear friend for it. In order to protect Karim, Mostafa confesses that he himself is the alleged rapist. When the brothers come out of jail, they seek to revenge Kaka Mostafa.

title: Safar-e-Ishq
description: Safar-e-Ishq is a captivating Pakistani Film. This enthralling tale revolves around the poignant journey of love between a humble tour guide and a beautiful girl, whose paths cross amidst the picturesque mountains of Swat Valley.

title: Hoosh-e Siah
description: Major Ahmadi is the Deputy Director of the Anti-Corruption Prevention and Combating Computer Crime Center, who has been involved with the complex case of a dengerous killer and a genius hacker named Jamshid Kazemi ,also known as Kamran bouryaei.

title: Orgulho e Preconceito
description: Apesar da pressão social para se casar, Lizzie Bennet, a segunda mais velha das irmãs Bennet, está decidida a ficar para titia. No entanto, quando seu pai é acometido por uma doença grave, Lizzie é inesperadamente lançada no mundo classista dos relacionamentos, na tentativa de salvar sua família da ruína financeira. Após um encontro fatídico com o enigmático e misterioso milionário Sr. Darcy, Lizzie se vê obrigada a escolher entre ir contra os seus sentimentos pelo bem de sua família ou se permitir viver uma paixão imprudente.

title: Qatal E Aam
description: Ranvir Singh Rana, a former Jailor, who is on a mission to capture Dacoit Bageera, who has escaped from prison - Dead or Alive.

title: Shaheed-E-Azam
description: The film, based upon the life of Shaheed Bhagat Singh, caused some controversy as the Punjab and Haryana High Court issued a notice to the producers calling for a ban of the movie.It was released in 2002. In the same year two other movies on Bhagat Singh were also released named '23d march 1931 Shaheed' and 'The Legend of Bhagat Singh'.

title: Wojnarowicz: F--k You F-ggot F--ker
description: A controversial artist blazes a trail for other gay image makers in New York 's 1980s scene, only to perish at the end of the decade from the AIDS virus.

description: Jas' boyfriend breaks up with her because she's boring. To prove him wrong, and just to continue to be with him, she agrees to be his f*** buddy.

title: Killing John F. Kennedy
description: John F Kennedy was one of America's greatest presidents. He was the voice of the people who was a natural public speaker and a cool calm figure in front of the cameras. His influence helped push America through the most dangerous moments of the cold war, diffusing what could have been world nuclear destruction. But in November 1963, his life would come to a devastating end through the hands of an assassin. But who would kill one of the most popular presidents? Why was he a target? Join us as we investigate the life and career of JFK and ask the question...Who was really behind the killing of JFK?

title: F*ck, Kill Mary
description: Seven sorority initiates are left to fend for themselves in the woods alone in 1999, where a masked killer with a mirror shard kills them one by one.

title: 23-F: la película
description: The failed coup of 23 February 1981, which began with the takeover of the Spanish parliament and ended with the release of parliamentarians, put Spanish democracy in serious risk. description: G Request Entertainment is a registered Irish company which was founded in 2005. Our main aim is to promote Irish musicians and help creative people in showcasing their talents on television. During 2005, we decided to set up a program in Tramore, Co. Waterford. What encouraged us to develop this community program, was that we thought Tramore was such a quiet place and there were little social activities offered for the youth within community development at the weekends. We thought that by offering a social event every weekend it would help benefit the community. Our activities and the shows we organized were able to bring both the Irish and the migrants of the community together and furthermore helped to enhance the cultural interests between the two different cultures through entertainment. In 2006 we thought of the possibility of expanding it into a nationwide program due to the encouragement and positive feedback from the public in response to our programs, hence we have traveled to sixteen counties within Ireland portraying our ideas. To date, we have achieved our main aim, to be able to broadcast our program on Sky platform and also be able to achieve our permanent production resident studio that includes a live audience, production equipment and professional men and women trained in the field, working with our organization.

title: Bobby G. Can't Swim
description: Bobby G. lives life on the edge in this real, raw New York street drama. Bobby is a small-time coke dealer, always on the hustle but rarely successful. He lives in Hell's Kitchen with his Puerto Rican girlfriend Lucy, who makes ends meet as a prostitute. A typical day finds Bobby selling $20 bags to neighborhood locals and passing cars. A yuppie kid looking to score a kilo of coke approaches him to broker a deal and Bobby sees the opportunity of a lifetime to make some real money. His rough days may just be over. With the tidy profit he could even leave the business. Playing out of his league, Bobby arranges to get the kilo from Astro, a fearsome, high-level drug dealer. Though Lucy announces that she's decided to go back to Puerto Rico and pleads with him to make a fresh start too, Bobby is sticking to his deal and isn't going anywhere now, convinced he'll be 'livin' large in a matter a' days. "On deal day the client gets nervous and the plan goes awry with Bobby turning over the merchandise without being able to hold on to the cash. He now fears for his life unless he can come up with the money, fast, to pay back Astro. Seized with panic Bobby seeks out an acquaintance, Dollar Bill, who puts him in touch with a mob figure who needs somebody "whacked" and is willing to pay big bucks for it too. Though Bobby has never fired a gun in his life, he carries out the execution. The act plunges him into a state of shock and torment verging on madness. In the ensuing hours, Bobby, his mind in a daze, will find redemption in a bizarre journey involving a homeless woman, the Hudson River, and a blind street-peddler named Popeet. He will also learn, that what fate may give, she is just as free to take away.

title: A 60 km/h
description: The Citroen Méhari is a lightweight all-terrain vehicle: 600 cc, two-cylinder and 28 HP, with a maximum speed of 60 kilometers (37 miles) per hour. Divorced and lonely, a Uruguayan named Mario Sabah decided to realize a longtime dream for his 50th birthday and tour the world in this car. So he quit his job and fixed up the blue Méhari that once served as the family wagon. Together with a camera and his two sons, he then embarked on a 150,000-kilometer (93,000-mile) journey across 45 countries and five continents. Once on the road, it doesn't take long for tensions to mount. After a clash of personalities halfway through Latin America, Mario continues alone, all the way to Canada. Sometimes he drives 600 kilometers at a stretch without even realizing it. "Do not ask me what happened in the middle, because I cannot tell." Once he is way up north, he puts the Méhari on the boat to Spain, and from there he travels through Europe, Asia and even Australia, defying heat, rain, dirt and all forms of chaos along the way - with plenty of stamina, far too little money and at a speed that's crucial to the story. In the words of his son Mattias, "At 60 kilometers per hour, you're like a chameleon. You go slowly, transforming along with the landscape you're going through."

description: 17 year old schoolgirl Sakura visits a Samurai theme park called Survival Land with her friends where they're supposed to go up against some cosplayers dressed as samurai but things go horribly wrong when one of the cosplayers gets infected after finding a strange flower in the theme park's grounds and cutting it with his sword. title: I Wish I Never Met You
description: Lauren Thomas is turning 40 and no one is more excited than her. She is married to an amazing husband, a true provider and father: Andrew Thomas. Andrew's brother, Franklin, is in a wheelchair due to a military attack. His wife, Mahogany, is currently pregnant with their first child. The two couples, along with three other couples and a few friends, are celebrating Lauren's birthday during the holidays since she is a Christmas baby. However, once the other women grow tired of Lauren bragging about her success, even though she is a stay-at-home wife, attitudes and snide comments take control. Over the course of the evening, things escalate and the entire cast gradually gets involved in the free-for-all until everything hits the proverbial fan. Everyone has dealt with someone that they wish they never met. What happens when you have more than a dozen of them in the same house? Find out in "I Wish I Never Met You."

title: Magtskifte i straffelejren - opgøret i Sønderjylland
description: After the 2. world war 3500 men from the german minority in the southern part of Jutland in Denmark where sent to the prisoner camp - "Faarhus". Before and during the war they had been heavily involved in national socialism and supporting the German occupation of Denmark from 1940-45. Now they had to pay for their loyalty against Denmark. Members of the german minority in Denmark is telling their families story in this documentary, with archive footage never shown before on television.

title: I Will... I Will... For Now
description: Elliott Gould and Diane Keaton take out a lease on love with an option to buy in this glossy romantic comedy costarring Paul Sorvino, Victoria Principal and Candy Clark. Unhappily divorced after 10 years of marriage, Les Bingham (Gould) finally convinces his ex-wife Katie (Keaton) to give him another shot. Reluctantly agreeing to a legal arrangement instead of a wedding vow, Les signs a six-month contract, unaware his lawyer (Sorvino) also loves Katie and plans to use the wiles of their sexy neighbor (Principal) to bust up the Binghams for good. Cowritten and directed by Norman Panama (How to Commit Marriage), I Will... I Will... For Now was produced by George Barrie, CEO of Fabergé. A musician-turned-businessman, Barrie would produce over a dozen films, earning Oscar nominations for "All That Love Went to Waste" (A Touch of Class, 1973) and "Now That We're in Love" (Whiffs, 1975), two songs he wrote with Sammy Cahn.

title: I Am What I Play
description: From the 1960s to the 1980s, the rock radio DJ played an unprecedented creative role in the rock music world. I Am What I Play profiles four disc jockeys in major markets during this period: their programming, their politics and their deep connections with musicians and fans in the heyday of rock radio. Where are they now - and how did they reinvent themselves as the medium changed? Featuring the music of The Ramones, Joni Mitchell, Rush, David Bowie, The Cars, The Sonics and more.

title: Do I love you, robot, do I?
description: Anthropomorphic robots are increasingly being introduced into our lives: they meet us at the reception, educate children and even live in families as partners. Scientists are trying to make robots as human-like as possible. In the late 80s, scientists studying the emotional reaction of people to robots discovered the "uncanny valley effect": the most humanoid robots caused dislike and even fear in people. But what will happen when they become indistinguishable from a person? And will they?

title: I Razor
description: Told from the perspective of a former scientist turned wandering telepathic man-child, I Razor is the story of one man's quest to regain his lost humanity. Gregory Fleer, a young scientist who has developed a new brain-altering substance called I Razor, is transformed by his own experiment and must negotiate his way through a world twisted beyond recognition by his altered perceptions. The film begins with Dr. Fleer already transformed, and teamed with his equally afflicted companion The Professor, who possesses certain inexplicable magic powers. Together, the Sergeant and Professor experience visions, perform music, and take a dark journey through a world populated by a tribe of fellow "freaks" and their leader, the phantasmagoric Mother Skinny, along with her right hand subhuman creation, The Homunculus. When the Professor abandons the Sergeant, the Sergeant finds some solace in the natural world, but his yearning to reclaim what he believes to be his lost identity unwittingly draws him back into the fray of society, where a struggle between good and evil awaits him.

title: To Tulsa and Back: On Tour with J.J. Cale
description: There's not really a plot, since this is a Documentary. In my opinion, it's a very good, very entertaining, documentary of the second half of the 2004 JJ Cale Band tour. I'm Rocky, the piano player in the band. It's really accurate, factual and honest. Cale has somehow got a reputation as a recluse, which is undeserved. The fact is: he has always avoided fame, since he thinks, correctly, that fame gets in the way of freedom and friendship. For this film, he set that aside and stepped out for his fans and friends. The John Cale I have known since 1957 is the John Cale you will see in this film. Many of the mysteries people have been curious about are made plain, even the true story of where the nickname "JJ" came from (the story in the various "Histories of Rock" is inaccurate). There's plenty of really good concert footage and some charming episodes of just John, doodling on guitar and singing his songs, in parking lots and back rooms. You will get to know the supporting cast, from band members to sound guys and roadies, members of the management team and friends sitting in. This DVD is an absolute must for anybody who was ever curious about the man behind the music they love. I think the fact that the film crew came over from Munich added much to the effectiveness of the film, since they were obviously charmed by Americans and the American countryside. There's also footage from the 2004 Crossroads Festival, from the first half of the tour, and interviews with Eric Clapton, who sat in with us on the Saturday.
