title: K²
description: In this comedy, Kate and Kevin live very boring, ordinary lives. When these two friends finally meet, they decide to do something to change their dull lives in an unconventional way by setting out to become superheroes, despite lacking special powers, training or anything else that one might associate with being a superhero. With this new-found perspective on life and the feel-good idea of saving people, Kevin and Kate start running towards any trouble they can find. To their surprise, being a homemade hero isn't always easy, especially when it's time to use the training that you don't have.

title: R. K. Laxman Ki Duniya
description: This TV series is based on the books and works of R. K. Laxman. The episodes and incidents would involve happenings in the life of the common man as depicted by Laxman over the years. This series would focus on the character of the common man who is a silent spectator of marching time. Meek and silent , the common man is a witness to everything: scheming politicians, gossiping housewives and rapacious bureaucrats.

title: Puteshestvie k tsentru dushi
description: Saga about the lives of two young women, Rita and Vera, who became closest friends at a crucial historical moment of USSR's collapse. The story covers twenty years of their life. Because of the love for the same man, Maksim, Rita and Vera turn from the best friends into deadly enemies, dangerous for each other. Bitterly envious of Rita, insidious Vera is dreaming to get her hands not only on Rita's love, but also on her money and her life. At the same time, Rita wishes to start her life from scratch. And one day fate gives each of them a unique chance: to start their life anew. However, old grievances and sins do not allow Vera to forget about the past and stop hating her more successful and pure friend Rita.

title: A.S.K.
description: Azra and Kerem is a couple who meets Sebnem, however Sebnem doesn't know they're together. Sebnem has cancer, the doctor said she will die soon. Sebnem is in love with Kerem. Kerem and Azra decides to get Kerem in a relationship with Sebnem.

title: Love Song for Illusion
description: A fantasy historical drama romance that crosses between a man with two opposite personalities and a woman who loves him, fresh love and fierce obsession.

title: Pinocchio 3000
description: The year is 3000. Geppetto, with the help of his faithful assistant, Spencer the cyber penguin, and by the holographic fairy Cyberina, creates Pinocchio, a prototype super-robot equipped for emotions.

title: Modeonpameo [Hindi]
description: In search of inspiration, rock band "Excellent Souls" - Lee Min Ki (Lee Hong Ki), Kang Hyeok (Park Min Woo), Yoo Han Cheol (Lee Si Un) - goes on hiatus deep in the countryside. To their surprise, the village elder is none other than Kang Yoon Hee (Honey Lee), a zippy woman who's not only the town's first female leader, but also the youngest. She also just so happens to be bandleader Min Ki's first love. Amidst a rural backdrop, these scrappy rockers take stock of what stirs their passions - both musical and romantic.

title: Ugly Alert
description: Joon-soo is sent to prison for a murder he didn't commit. During his incarceration, Joon-soo is taught how to sew. After his release, Joon-soo is hired by a fashion company. Joon-soo eventually falls in love with a co-worker named Do-hee.

title: A Yellow Bird
description: Siva, a Singaporean-Indian man is released after in prison for contraband smuggling. Unable to find forgiveness form his mother, he begins a quest to locate his ex-wife and daughter. Just as he finds solace and hope in the company of an illegal Chinese prostitute, he is confronted with an unbearable truth about his family. How far he will go in order to redeem himself from guilt?

title: Melo Movie
description: A jaded film critic reunites with an aspiring director after years apart due to a mysterious event. Their reunion triggers buried memories and emotions, leading them to confront their shared past.

title: Guns 'n' Moses
description: A day in the life of the Jewish settlement of Hebron, the tomb of Abraham and the stronghold of the Israeli religious right.A polyphonic tale of spirituality and violence. Guns'n'Moses is a documentary about the Israeli ultra nationalist-religious settlers and their ideology in their own words . Their accounts interweave to create a fabric in which stand up their concepts of time and space, their idea of identity and enemy, the Divine plan underlying the daily life and the same use of the violence. Modern prophets carrying assault rifles, hippies devoted to the Cabala and the American folk music, techno-dancers longing for the Redemption and mothers proud to raise the future soldiers of the Messiah. Shakespeare's play has never lost its urgency, proving its greatness in terms of genre and message. Now, "Romeo n' Juliet" depicts the contemporary love story of a young Latvian girl, Juliet, and a Russian guy, Romeo.

title: La persona de Leo N.
description: As a twelve-year-old boy, Nicola de Leo already knew she wanted to become a woman. Today, the now forty-year-old transsexual lives in Venice and has changed her name to Nicole. She has undergone a hormone treatment and grown breasts, but she still lives inside the body of a middle-aged man, including a penis, a beard and a substantial Adam's apple. This is why Nicole is applying for a sex change through official channels. 'I never thought it would be so hard. I thought making the decision was enough,' she says. During five tense years, Nicole fights her emotional and physical struggle in the presence of director Alberto Vendemmiati's camera. Working as an actress, a seller of carnival masks and a prostitute, she finances her cosmetic treatments and looks forward to the subsidised sex change operation. Meanwhile, she turns to her elderly mother for support, who has a hard time accepting that her son will soon be a daughter.

description: Contemplating the failure of his life, Rogério drinks until losing control of his actions and involves himself in a bar brawl. description: 1935. Giorgos Sakaflias has the reputation of the toughest man of Trikala. He loves the beautiful but poor Lenio, while the rich Nora wants him. Nakas, who wants Lenio his own, will blame Sakaflias for the murder of Smyrnia's prostitute. Nora, too, when she does not succumb to her appetites, will blame him for rape. Sakaflias will leave from Trikala. The police will ring him and start looking for him.

title: O Grão
description: The elderly Perpétua, feeling the approach of death, decides to prepare Zeca, her beloved grandson, to the inevitable. She tells him the story of a king and a queen, a wealthy and powerful couple who lost their only child but wishes to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Damião e Josefa work hard to support their family and to prepare their daughter Fátima's wedding. At the end, the tale told by Perpétua and the destiny of that family will cross.

title: O Encontro
description: Lisbon, 2003: a series of workshops and seminars about interculturalism and the performing arts takes place during a whole summer month, led by anthropologist André Lepecki with guest choreographers and dance teachers from a multitude of countries.

title: O gabros mou, o proikothiras
description: A man who already has a long-term relationship gets involved with a love-smitten heiress; however, his good friend and colleague isn't willing to take this situation lying down. Now, let's see how he will manage to get out of this mess.

title: O Casal
description: Couple with emotional and financial problems find out that the woman is pregnant. The decision to have the baby or not ends up distressing their relationship.

title: O retorno da luz - o início
description: In 1986, 21 unidentified flying objects were detected by the radars in Brasília and São Paulo, and 5 fighters took off to intercept them. A girl is born from this moment and, 10 years later, a second one, with different views of the world, ability to heal and move objects, and much superior intelligence, which can affect everything and everyone around her, bringing with them, the return of light.

title: O Donzelo
description: In the countryside, the virgin hick Nestor sees a naked model taking pictures and chases her through the fields and village. His father decides to pay for the services of the local prostitute Marli, but Nestor feels repulse for the whore and his father expels him from the village. Nestor travels by foot and hitchhiking and along his journey, he meets his cousin; the young prostitute Janete "Tutuquinha" in a brothel; the young Dulce that is participating of a scavenger hunt in her Fiat No. 18; the charming actress Leila; but their encounters do not meet his expectation and Nestor does not lose his virginity. When he arrives in Rio de Janeiro, he is arrested and in the jail he meets a travesty. When he is released, he finally fulfills his mission.

title: O boufos

title: O Tronco

title: O Teos kai o Stavros
description: In the island of Syros, his place of residence, filmmaker Stavros Kaplanidis meets writer Teos Romvos. The two of them have come a long way together: schoolmates, Paris in the years of the military junta, in the alternative culture hangouts, Exarchia in the Metapolitefsi years... A life's sum up that etches the joint portrait of two free-spirited artists of anarchist ideology, who were never pinned down on labels both in life and in the arts they loyally served.

title: O Outro

title: O Touro

title: O-Town

The mysterious filmmaker has a near omnipresent overview of the pimps, the scam artists, and the drug dealers as they ravage the moral backbone of a town wholly subjugated by a sadistic and suavely mannered gangster, simply known as The Chairman... but not for much longer.

title: O pappous mou o Papaflessas
description: A tender look at the hero of the Greek Revolution of 1821. Papaflessas traveled to Constantinople in the age of enlightenment and romanticism, and became a member of the revolutionary organization "Filiki Eteria" (Society of Friends), taking on the task of inciting his compatriots against the Ottoman Empire. description: Sixth-grade pupil Katka daydreams during a maths class about being Snow White and being freed by a prince who looks very much like Dzery from the eighth grade. Katka, her girl friends Lenka and Martina, and her fellow-pupils Franta, Joska and freckled Vrabcák, have spent five years going to the same little one-class school in their home mountain village of Pastvina. Their kind teacher Smetácek was very understanding about their games and fantasies, but he didn't teach them much about arithmetic. They are now laughed at for their ignorance by the strict Bidlo, their new teacher at the near-by little town. As he does every year, Smetácek is preparing a theatre performance with the local children. Katka suggests the fairytale about Snow White.

title: O Bolão
description: Dominated by his mother-in-law, man working at a record store dreams of winning a popular lottery. There are others with the same dream: a tourist agent, a man working at a gas-station and a couple whose relationship turned sour and can't stand each other's presence any longer. Some of them do win, and break up with everything around them: relatives, bosses, lifestyles... only to find later that the prize must be shared with thousands of other winners.

title: Daddy O, Baby O!
description: Middle-aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a turnaround when his dying friend Arnold makes him promise to take care of his daughter Anna. But Anna is not an ordinary little girl. Despite her angelic look, she's mischievous and in search of her estranged mother.

title: O tromokratis
description: Three bosom friends and members of the Humanitarian Movement of Greece pluck up the courage to abduct an affluent industrialist to obtain the necessary money for the election campaign. But, are ideas enough to make a difference?

title: Straw
description: A series of devastating events leads a single mother down an unforeseen path on which she becomes embroiled in an unthinkable situation and lands in the center of suspicion in an indifferent world.

title: O Azarento
description: The misadventures of a very unlucky guy born on a small city and his struggling efforts to succeed. Known by everybody as "The Unlucky Guy" (O Azarento), the man was born on a Friday 13th, at 13:00. Terrifying the citizens with his bad luck wave, he becomes a loner. Everywhere he passes by, turns everything upside down. He causes panic at a party and was chased by angry people. He pleas for change. With no perspectives and challenging his fate, he moves to a bigger city so he can find a better place to live. Otherwise he starts a plenty of small disasters on the road, causing an accident between two cars but remains alive with any bruises. This way he fakes his condition and try to go to a hospital. On his way, he causes the ambulance breakdown. With the help of a truck load of boxes he manages to arrive to the city of Goias. Unluckily, the trucker loses all of his load. His girlfriend tries to follow him, but she managed to have another affair on the big city, forgetting him. The "Azarento" was a menace at the hotel, on the streets, even at the prison, releasing all the inmates and causing confusion at a bank robbery, a funeral and on the traffic. The news were reporting everything and the "Unlucky man" becomes a known dangerous influence. But something is about to change his life forever: a pair of shoes that allows him to keep away the bad luck waves. He was even called by an advertising agency for a shoes ad campaign, amplifying its sales. But new wacky things happen when he takes his soes off.

title: Vice Ganda, bakit pagod na pagod sa Laro Laro Pick?!
description:
Dahil papalapit na Pasko, mag-practice na para sa paparating na mga Christmas parties. Perfect sa intermission number ang ‘Meme’ dance challenge ng Showtime Baby Dolls. Ang trio naman nina Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga, at Brent Manalo nag-practice na ng caroling. Si Ryan Bang, may natanggap daw na Christmas gift mula kay Ogie Alcasid last year na never niya malilimutan.

Sa 'Miss Q and A', talino at wit ang puhunan sa entablado para maputungan ng korona sa ulo. Sumabak sa talakan sina Louie Chua, isang breadwinner na sanay lumaban para sa pamilya; Klara Espedido, ang academic achiever na mahusay rin na manunulat, at Rubi Serenio, na pagme-makeup ang bread and butter.

Ang tatlong kandidata, lumiwanag ang mga mata nang masilayan ang idol nila, walang iba kund si Vice Ganda. Si Louie, hindi pinalampas ang pagkakataong makapagbigay ng mensahe ng pasasalamat kay Meme, “Thank you for lifting my personality and also encouraging me to keep pushing everyday.”

Maya-maya pa, mas kinilala nina Vice, Vhong Navarro at Ogie Alcasid ang mga kandidata. Si Klara, nagbahagi ng isang alamat na siya mismo ang sumulat, habang si Rubi naman ay game na sinipat ang mukha ni Ogie para alamin kung anong makeup look ang babagay rito.

Sa Tumpak Ganern round, si Rubi ang nalotlot sa laban habang sina Louie at Klara ang umabante sa Wit Lang para subukan kung sino ang mas may bitaw sa talakan.

Ngayong Teacher's Month, saluduhan natin ang mga gurong may malaking puso para sa serbisyo at sa mga kabataan. Hindi lang aral ang ibinibigay nila kundi pagmamahal at suporta. Kaya this Friday, mga Special Needs Education teachers ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Teacher Rose, na maituturing na hero sa classroom. Kamakailan lang, nagtamo siya ng injury matapos magwala ang isa niyang estudyante, patunay na extra lakas ng loob ang kailangan sa napili niyang propesyon. Kaya nanawagan si Vice Ganda para sa mas maayos na insurance at protection para sa mga guro, lalo na sa mga Special Needs Education teachers.

Pagkatapos ng mga challenges at mahaba-habang ‘Laro Laro Pick’ final round na ikinapagod ni Meme, kay Teacher Rose talaga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante.

Sa jackpot round, mas idinetalye ni Teacher Rose ang nangyari sa kanyang injury.Iniligtas pala niya ang isang estudyanteng nagwala at muntik nang masagasaan, kaya sa kanyang tapang at malasakit bilang guro, mas lalo siyang hinangaan.

Para may pandagdag sa gastusin, sinugalan niya ang ₱150,000 POT question tungkol sa ibig sabihin ng NCAP, ang programa ng MMDA. Makakapuntos kaya si Teacher Rose at maiuuwi ang POT money?

title: P-POP Domination
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

title: DPWH?! Jhong, ginatungan ang pamumuksa ni Ion kay Vice
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

Kahit napagod sa biyahe na tumagal dahil sa baha, laban pa rin si Jemzian. Si Kea naman ay isang optometrist na Rank 7 sa board exam. At pinatunayan nga niya ang pagiging brainy nang mapa-wow niya si Vice Ganda dahil hindi pa man tapos basahin ang tanong ay agad siyang nakasagot—complete with a full explanation!

Sina Kea at Jemzian ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At para bang meant to be ang nabunot na tanong ni Kea, “Kung isa kang optometrist, anong ia-advise mo sa pasyente kapag sinabi niyang malabo ang kanyang third eye?”

Pero mas meant to be ang korona kay Jemzian, na tumatak sa mga hurado at Madang People dahil sa nagkandaligaw-ligaw niyang sagot sa tanong na, “Anong mas masakit? Bigyan ka ng mag-asawang sampal o sampalin ka ng mag-asawa?”

Mapa-araw o gabi, sila ang tagabantay ng safety. Sila ang mga hardworking security guards mula Pasig City.

Inspirasyon ni Koriks ang limang anak. Kaya para sa kanilang pag-aaral, willing siyang sumugal para sa ₱200,000 POT money. Kinumbinsi naman siya nina Brent Manalo, Ralph de Leon, at ng Baby Dolls na kunin ang P30,000 Li-Pot offer sa pamamagitan ng dance number.

Pero sa huli, pinakinggan ni Koriks ang gusto ng anak na subukan ang POT question. Dahil gusto ni Meme Vice na masayang umuwi si Koriks, binigyan niya ito ng sampung libo.

Ano nga ba ang pinakakilig na ginagawa nila sa isa't isa? Kung si Dustin ay kinikilig sa luto ni Bianca, si Bianca naman ay solb na ang kilig sa ngiti pa lang ni Dustin.

Pati si Jhong Hilario ay hindi nakaiwas sa charisma ng fangirl na si Arah. Lotlot man siya sa kompetisyon, feeling winner pa rin si Arah dahil sa moments nila ni Kuys Jhong. Samantala, 'may bitaw' ang talak nina Ian at Anora as they faced their respective questions sa Wit Lang round.

Agad bumuhos ang emosyon sa laro dahil sa life story ni player Kalbo, na tinitiis ang pagod at hirap para tulungan ang mga pamangkin sa kanilang mga pangarap. Samantala, si Darren Espanto, humingi ng space kay Jackie Gonzaga. Our DaCkie hearts! Huhu! Pero mabuti na lang aktingan lang 'to!

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
To start the month of October, nagpasiklab sa "It's Showtime" stage ang six-member Japanese dance and vocal boy band na Be:First. Sa unang araw ng Oktubre, entertainment ay libre at sagot 'yan ng mga beki na palaban sa "Miss Q and A." Walang aatrasan sa talakan sina Jouji Medina, Jane Estolora, at Ayesa Pido Quilang.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, sakto sa BER months, 'Santa Claus 'scamming' to town' daw ang bagay na kanta para kay Jouji at sa jowa nito dahil parang hindi tugma ang mga kuwento. Si Jane naman, very Barbie ang awrahan kaya pinarampa ni Meme sa harapan. Action star na nag-transition naman ang dating ni Ayesa sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, at ang boses daw nito para bang tunog tsismosa.

Araw ito nina Ayesa at Jouji dahil sila ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Nag-loading man nang bahagya, naitawid pa rin ni Jane ang talak sa tanong na, "Saan dadaan si Santa Claus kung wala namang chimineya sa bahay n'yo?" Hindi naman sa nagmamaasim pero palaban ang chukchak ni Jouji sa tanong na, "Ikagagalit ba ng sinigang na mas maasim ka sa kan'ya?"

Ang totoong naasiman, si hurado Brent Manalo, dahil sa joke ng kaibigan niyang escort, Ralph de Leon. Pinakitaan pa niya si Ralph kung paano bumitaw ng pangmalakasang joke. Naging escort of the day rin si Darren Espanto, and true to his branding, ang mga jokes ni Darren idinaan sa singing.

Sa tiangge, dapat marunong tumawad. Dapat din naka-smile lang ang nagbebenta par ng swerte ay pumasok na. Kaya sa Laro Laro Pick, sold out ang good vibes at may sukli pang jackpot para sa mga players na tindera.

Nakakuwentuhan ng hosts si Alona, na halatang-halata ang saya nang makita nang personal si Vice Ganda. Pero maya-maya, si Meme Vice kinabahan. 'Yung tingin daw kasi ni Alona, parang may bulong.

No return, no exchange, sabi nila. Pero si palyer Maye, naka-return sa game arena matapos mabunot ang pangalan niya. Naniniwala siyang kalooban ng Panginoon ang paglalaro niya sa jackpot round kung saan umabot na sa P400,000 ang POT money.

Nag-goodbye si Maye sa P40,000 Li-Pot offer at sinugalan ang katanungan na may kinalaman sa 13th month pay ng isang private employee. Higit pa nga sa 13th month pay ang biyayang dumating kay Maye dahil nasungkit nito ang POT question!

description:
Representing mga kabataang matatayog ang pangarap at maaasahan sa anumang hamon, P-Pop group CLOUD 7, hindi inatrasan ang 'Oohh Lala Baby' dance challenge.

Parang kidlat na gumuguhit sa langit, ang mga kandidata ng 'Miss Q and A,' pasabog ang wit! Hindi nagpakabog sa isa't isa sina candidates Mima Linda, Shanaya, at Gel Balantac.

Sa magkabilang gilid, sina Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro, panay ang bulong kay Vice Ganda. Baka naman daw na-scam sila ni Mima Linda, na para bang pagpapanggap lang ang kabaklaan dahil sa awrahang matigas, 'yung tipong patutumbahin ang mga kalalakihan sa suntukan. Si Nicole Cordoves nga, hinarana't pinormahan!

May sariling 'amats' din si Shanaya, na idinaan sa dance steps ang pang-aasar kay Mima Linda. Samantalang si Gel, tahimik lang at tagaktak ang pawis habang nagpupuksaan ang dalawang kasama. Pawis, este, panis kayo sa kanya!

Maraming nasorpresa na si Gel pa ang naunang makasagot nang tama, matapos ang mahaba at nakakapagod na Round 1 kung saan litong-lito ang mga 'atecco' kung ano ang 'kidlat' at 'kulog' sa Ingles. Kaya today, mga ses? Sumunod kay Gel si Shanaya sa Round 2, samantalang si Mima Linda ay tuluyang nag-babu! Sino ang itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day? ‘Yung Mama ay blue, o ‘yung Papa ay red?

Sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena, lumaban nang masigasig ang mga taga-Santolan, Pasig. Si player Annes ang kinapitan ng swerte! Hindi pa man pumipili kung POT o Li-POT, feeling winner n si Annes sa kilig na hatid nina Ralph de Leon, Brent Manalo at Darren. 'Sana all' na lang talaga ang masasabi mo!

Mukhang may nainggit! Hala! Si Jackie Gonzaga, abang na abang, feel na feel ang eksena kasama ang tatlong gwapo! Pero ano 'tong chika?! Si Jackie, may ka-talking stage na taga-GMA?!

Umepek naman ang sales talk ng mga pogi, dahil si Annes, Li-POT ang pinili. Nag-uwi siya ng P20,000!

title: Miss Q&A candidates 'NAGKAINITAN' sa 1st weekly finals
description:
Sa isang Sabadong makulay, mga beki na fierce ang nagpamalas ng wit at nagpalaganap ng good vibes sa unang weekly finals ng "Miss Q and A."

Kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagrampa sina Miss Jawo ng Antipolo City, Kelly Agustin ng Nueva Ecija, Elisse Kagandahan Alamo ng Quezon City, Miss Mia ng Malolos Bulacan, Andrea Jane ng Del Monte Quezon City, at Barbie Bratz Ayuda ng Trece Martires Cavite.

Agad uminit ang puksaan ng mga kandidata dahil lahat ay sumabak with full confidence. Sina Barbie Bratz at Miss Jawo, mainit ang dugo sa isa't isa. Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kung sino pang magkamukha, sila pa ang nag-aaway!

Mula sa anim na nagpabilisan at nagpatalinuhan sa 'TumPAK Ganern' round, apat lang ang umabante sa 'WIT Lang' kung saan self-expression at pagiging creative sa mga sagot ang naging labanan. Sina Miss Jawo, Barbie, Kelly at Elisse ang pumasok sa second round.

At mula naman sa kanilang apat, sina Miss Jawo ang Kelly ang nag-face-off sa BEKLAMATION kung saan iisang tanong lamang ang kanilang sinagot. Ito ay kung anong makeup product ang ibibigay nila sa kanilang tatay.

Parehong 'lipstick' ang naisip nilang sagot, pero nagkaiba sa lalim ng paliwanag. Mas tumatak kina hurado Alexa Ilacad, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kelly, kaya siya ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna TalakERA of the week! Nakakuha si Kelly ng average score na 9.3, samantalang 8 naman ang grado ni Miss Jawo.

Masaya ang selebrasyon para sa mga tatay na puno ng dedikasyon. Minsan seryoso, minsan ay korni ang banat. Pero kahit magkakaiba, pagmamahal at sipag nila ay palaging sapat. Happy Father's Day sa mga madlang tatay!

Saludo tayo sa pagsisikap ni Mel, ang hardworking daddy, na walang sinasayang na oras sa pag-aalaga at pagtatrabaho for his family. Perfect naman for the celebration ang good vibes na dala ng Showtime hosts na sumalang sa bagong paboritong aktingan ng bayan, ang 'You Gotta Lyric' round.

Sina Vice at Vhong Navarro, parang na-enjoy ang 'physical' acting... parang totoo?! Heto ang siguradong totoo, para kay Mel ang araw na 'to! Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ng players, pangalan niya ang nabunot para maglaro sa jackpot round.

Dahil minsan lang ang ganitong experience, hindi nagpatinag si Mel na piliin ang POT question. May reward from the universe ang masisipag at matatapang! Dahil sa pagsugal niya sa POT, naiuwi ni Mel ang papremyong P300,000!

title: MC at Lassy hindi nagpakabog sa Miss Q&A stage
description:
Hindi suspended ang good vibes dito sa "It's Showtime" dahil tuloy-tuloy lang ang buhos ng tawanan at happiness. Parang Signal No. 4 ang intensity ng biritan sa FUNanghalian handog nina "TNT Duets" 2 champs Christian Tibayan at Arvery Lagoring.

Pati ang "Ohhh Lala Baby," naging mapanakit! Pero kung duet lang naman ang usapan, lalaban ang pares nina Jackie Gonzaga at Darren Espanto aka DaCkie d'yan! Eh, magpapakabog ba naman ang BreCkie?! Si Brent Manalo, nag-warm up pa, sabay 'da move' na siguradong kikiligin ka Dong digi digi dong! Aha!

Heto, may bago! Ralph de Leon at Lassy aka RalphSy! Hirit ni Lassy, kung siya ang pinili ni Ralph papunta sa kanyang puso, siguradong may papaldo!

Sa "Miss Q and A," kapag hindi alam ang sagot, you've got to shoot your shot, bes! Sabay ngiti at sabi ng, "And, I thank you!" Malakas ang arrive nina candidates JV Zeped, Audrey Zunega, at Carla Shuvee Medalla, na sa bawat hampas ng balakang sa pagrampa, ika'y mapapa-ohhh lala.

Sa "Wit Lang" kung saan sina Carla at Audrey ang nagharapan, nabunot ni Carla ang tanong na, "Payag ka kung passenger princess ka pero nakasabit ka?" Ang tanong naman kay Audrey, "Payag ka masarap ka magmahal pero wala kang panlasa?"

Mag-manicure ay 'di biro, maghapong nakayuko sa pagkuskos ng kuko. Kaya deserve ng mga madlang manikurista players ang isang masayang bonding at laro sa game arena.

It's giving girl power si nanay Lisa sa Laro Laro Pick. Ikinuwento niya ang hirap at sarap ng pagiging isang solo parent ngayong graduate na ang mga anak sa kolehiyo. Paldo naman sa kilig si Jelai dahil kay Vhong Navarro. At sa sobrang kilig, naligaw pa ang 'I love you' na para kay mister!

Ang naglaro sa jackpot, si Bhels, na 35 years nang itinataguyod ang pamilya sa pamamagitan ng mani-pedi. Kaya naman super deserve ni nanay ang P25,000 Li-Pot offer, na malaking ginhawa na para sa kan'yang pamilya.

title: Miss Pau 'LASING' nang sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Ang goal natin sa araw na 'to, maging masaya much. Kalimutan muna ang pighati at ang mga labi ay pintahan ng ngiti. Kalmahan muna ang mga puso, parang mga boses ng Sessionistas—Nyoy Volante, Kean Cipriano, Princss Velasco, at Sitti.

Laugh trip to the highest level kasi ang hatid nina Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Barbie Nhicole Gondra, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Kantahan sa malamig na FUNanghalian ang trip nila for today's video. Si Miss Pau, songwriting ang forte. Pagbirit naman ang talent ni Barbie. Pero lahat ng 'songerists' ay walang sinabi sa lakas ng loob ni Belle, na may balak pang mag-audition sa "Tawag Ng Tanghalan." Kaya, sample naman d'yan! Mukhang bagay nga kay Belle ang mag-TNT, dahil napansin ni Meme na kamukha nito si Sofronio Vasquez. Kaya naman si Belle, binansagan niyang Sofronia Vasquech.

Dahil benta kay Meme ang mga hirit nito, binigyan niya si Belle ng sariling entablado at pagkakataon na sagutin ang mga tanong na nabunot nina Miss Pau at Barbie sa Wit Lang round.

Kinontra ni Belle ang sagot ng dalawang kandidata. Dahil napatunayan ni Belle ang kakayahan sa tanungan, mukhang malaki ang pag-asa na makabalik siya sa Resbakan. Samantala, sa araw na 'to, kay Miss Pau ang korona bilang Reyna Talaka-Era.

Mula sa lugar na pinagmulan kasarinlan ng bayan, sumugod ang mga taga-Kawit, Cavite sa Laro Laro Pick game arena para subukan ang kanilang swerte.

Pagkatapos ng masasayang laro, ang naka-survive at umabante sa jackpot round ay ang proud housewife na si Yayie, na ilalaan ang mapapanalunan para suportahan ang pag-aaral at pangarap ng mga anak.

Para palakasin ang loob ni Yayie, binalikan ng 'Gen Z' hosts ang kanilang mga childhood dreams. Alam n'yo ba? Childhood dream ni Jackie Gonzaga na maging madre.

Back to the game, nakumbinsi ni Cianne Dominguez si Yayie na piliin ang Li-POT! Naku! Lagot! Alam pala ni Yayie ang tamang sagot!

title: Miss Q&A Jerica na-FEEL ang LAMBING ni Ryan
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?

title: You're Hired!
description:
After the "mysterious" death of a colleague, the doldrums of office life at DanRick Designs are given a surprise resuscitation when Miles Fuller and Dylan Kirkpatrick discover they are the lead candidates for a promotion. The timing of the advancement opportunity couldn't be more ideal for the entry-level employees. The Tech Center where Miles' voluntarily teaches inner city teens is low on funds, and Dylan is desperate to purchase the home his deceased father built by hand, before his mother is manipulated by his weasel stepdad to put it on the market. The pay increase from the promotion could resolve their dilemmas, except only one of them can win the job.

Peers and family deceive the young men into believing racial disparities always impact office politics, so assertive, yet questionable actions, may be necessary to level the playing field if they really want the job. Is ethical compromise justified for a moral cause? Miles and Dylan will journey down a rabbit hole that not only answers the question, but drops them in the middle of chaos and high jinks so wild, staying alive becomes more vital than the job!

With a colorful cast (literally) of quirky characters, You're Hired, explores both internal and external perceptions and struggles of race and identity. This social satire avoids political correctness, opting to poke fun at the ignorance and insecurities that create unnecessary division. Sometimes laughing at stereotypes is simply wiser than allowing them validity, especially in today's America.

title: Galaxy Angel S
description: Galaxy Angel special that contains 2 stories. During an infiltration of the Angels' base, Milfeulle grabs a grenade and runs off with it, sacrificing herself to save her friends. Later on, she wakes up, believing it all to have been a dream. Things seem off when Commander Volcott and the others can not see or hear her. Realizing she is now a ghost, Milfeulle must come to terms with memories of her friends, both good and bad. Commanders Mary and Volcott have been ordered to switch commands. Neither is very happy with the situation, but they make do. That is, until the Twin-star boys insult Commander Volcott's mustache. Enraged, he reverts to his old army self, the "White Supernova Wolf". The Angels try desperately to control their former leader while Mary sneaks off for some tea.

title: Léto s kovbojem

Honza likes the racy girl at the first sight and his directness imposes on Doubravka too. They start to date. Honza comes from a big family, he was degraded to a cowboy when he had a tractor accident caused by alcohol and lost his driving license. In the summer cabin, Doubravka takes care of Bobo (Oldrich Vízner) - a student of medicine who prepares for an one exam for the third time. He is selfish and in his uncertainty he behaves to Doubravka uninterestedly and outrageously. Honza supposes Doubravka looks after a crazy person, yet soon he learns that Bobo is Doubravka's boy-friend. On the other hand, Doubravka finds a girl's name tattooed on Honza's arm and troubles come.

The film reveals unknown details of the history of Bulgarian cinema and the link between the political elite and the intellectuals at the time.

title: 100% T-Shirt
description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

title: Drawn This Way
description: Drawn this Way (wt) is a one hour television documentary which dives into the pages of gay comic book characters and their creators. In the studio, in the comic book shops, at the fan-crazed conventions, and at home with the artists - we'll find out what it means to be a Doorq, how to come out of the closet as an HGN (hot gay nerd) and where our drawn adventures will take us next. title: The Good Sh*t
description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

title: U Turn
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.

title: A Girl in a Million
description: A young scientist freed by divorce from a nagging wife, isolates himself from women. His peace is broken by a lovely young girl to whom he is forced to give shelter. He marries her and finds that his dumb wife is not so dumb.

title: A Blonde for a Night
description: After an argument, a newlywed decides to test her husband's fidelity by disguising herself as a blonde.

title: A Kiss in a Taxi
description: Ginette, a waitress at the Café Pierre, loves Lucien, a poor artist, and objects to the attentions of others with whatever glassware is at hand, though Lucien's father forbids their marriage. While Leon Lambert and a "gay lady" are riding the boulevards, they stop at a florist's shop. At the same time, Ginette, pursued by her irate employer, runs down the boulevard and into the waiting taxi. Leon returns, offers a bouquet to the stranger, and forces a kiss; the chauffeur, losing control of the car, crashes through the cafe window. Leon buys the restaurant for Ginette, expecting her gratitude, but uses the card of Maraval, treasurer of the Artists' Society. To escape an awkward situation, Leon poses as Ginette's father, then forces Maraval to assert himself as the girl's lover; with complications resolved, the lovers are united.

title: CharmSukh: Jane Anjane Mein 6 Part 1
description: Chandni’s mundane and routine married life spices up, when her older brother in law arrives at their place to stay. Chandni’s loins start firing up, and thus starts a tug of war between her integral family values and her personal lustful adventure.

title: A Bit of a Stranger
description: Four generations of Ukrainian women from one family explore how their ethnic identity has been destroyed and embark on an emotional journey shaped by their new found memories and family history.

title: A Bomb for a Dictator
description: A revolution breaks out in a South American country while its cruel dictator is on a trip to France. The rebels have made careful plans to blow up the dictator's private plane as he returns, but at the last second he changes plans and travels on a commercial flight. The rebels then must make a difficult decision: they must either blow up a flight filled with innocent passengers, or else allow the dictator to return home and take brutal reprisals against the leaders of the uprising.

title: A Boy a Girl and a Dead Cat
description: Four high school students heading for the prom run over a cat and decide that they must bury it and give it a proper memorial service, and in so doing find adventure and redemption.

title: A Noiva
description: A European teenager ran away from home to marry a Daesh fighter. Three years later, her life has dramatically changed, living in an Iraqi prison camp now she has two children to take care of and is pregnant again.

title: Not a Feather But a Dot
description: A look at the history, perceptions, and evolution of the Indian-American community.

title: A New Thought, A New You
description: Get ready for an all-new spiritual exploration through film. Teachers and speakers from across the new thought movement come together to share their inspiring true stories of personal transformation. 'A New Thought, A New You' will take its audience on an uplifting journey, rising above adversity to living a fulfilling life of peace, well-being, abundance, and purpose.

title: A Pelada
description: A couple in crisis seeks a way to warm up the relationship. While Caio (Bruno Pêgo) flirts with other women, he realizes that he does not give due attention to his wife, Sandra (Kika Farias). She, in turn, proposes other alternatives to marriage.

title: Aprendiendo a Educar mejor a a niños y niñas pequeños
A Praça
description: In a run down neighborhood in east LISBON (Chelas), a public square undergoes renovation work which lasts three years. In this space, designed in pink, a depressed community, concentrated on their daily routine, lives out their lives increasingly indifferent to the outcome of the interminable public works.

description: It's easy to talk about teenagers, but we are now in our teens for the first time. All the moments were too serious to say I was not worried.

Although the school authorities allow him to continue with his job for a while, but all hell breaks loose when he starts getting threat calls from the management asking him to vacate his property that is situated right inside the school premises. Jayabrata, who had also been a student of the same school, could see through their real intention and simply refuses to budge.

title: C/O Surya
description: An easygoing youngster's life is disturbed with the entry of a local don.

title: Planet C: Home Race
description: Planet C: Home Race tells the story of the boys from Planet C who dream of debuting as global idols. They return to the launch pad and embark on a new journey with Star Creators from around the world.

title: Love is Sweet [Hindi]
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: Spring of the Blade
description: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

title: Until You Say Yes
description: Jamie Holt is deeply in love with Esme Carson and relentlessly pursues her, but his efforts only push her further away. On graduation day, she breaks down, begging him to let her go, and flees abroad to continue her studies. A decade passes, but fate isn't finished with them. When their paths cross again, Jamie is determined to leave Esme with no choice but to marry him.

title: My Three Protective Brothers
description: On the eve of her wedding, Natalia was cruelly betrayed by her scumbag fiancé, her reputation was ruined, and she lost everything! At a critical moment, her three long-lost elder brothers found her and revealed that she actually came from a wealthy family. From then on, she embarked on a life of being cherished by her family, seeking revenge on those who had hurt her, and reaching the pinnacle of her life!

title: Girlfriend [Hindi]
description: Bit-part actress, Wen Xiao Nuan, is hired to play An Ning Wen Hua's CEO, Ye Fei Mo's, secret admirer in order to earn funds to support the Huang Mei Opera group back in her hometown. The two fall in love while pretending to be lovers.

title: My CEO Husband in Waiter's Disguise
description: A successful, savvy CEO is betrayed by her fiancé, who cheats with another woman. Discovering the affair before her wedding, she boldly marries a seemingly ordinary waiter in front of stunned guests. Unbeknownst to all, the 'waiter' is actually a powerful CEO incognito, who quietly supports her through her company's crises, proving that her lost love has been beside her all along. Through trials, they rediscover trust and love, ready to face the future together.

title: New Hope City
description: One man's determination to rebuild a city in ruins puts his family in constant danger against the most notorious villains in the town.

title: The Third Letter Is My Goodbye
description: The Third Letter Is My Goodbye

title: Saigon, U.S.A.
description: Old wounds collide with new realities when a Vietnamese shopkeeper challenges the heart of the Vietnamese-American community with symbols of the communist regime from which they fled. Massive protests in Orange County's Little Saigon raise questions about individual versus community rights, generational differences, what it means to be Vietnamese-American and, ultimately, what it means to be American.

title: A Will Eternal S1-S3
description: Young man seeks for a long time to turn on the fairy light through lightning until he finds Li Qing

title: Ancient Miracle Healer
description: A poor young man, Qin Xiao, bullied by others, unexpectedly inherits the Golden Dragon Legacy from his grandfather, boosting his power. With skills in both medicine and martial arts, he is thrust into a web of intrigue, only to discover that everything is part of a conspiracy surrounding him.

title: In Love, In Power, In Possession
description: For five years, Jared Knight relentlessly pursued Emily York, only to be dismissed as a shameless suck-up. Heartbroken, he swore never to love again—until fate led him to rescue Giselle Morgan, a woman with a hidden identity as the heiress of a powerful underworld family. Just as Jared finally lets go of Emily, she suddenly starts chasing him instead.

title: Ice Fantasy [Hindi]
description: A fantasy story happens in a fictional universe. Ka Suo, the prince of the Snow Nation, takes the journey to the magical holy shrine with his entourages, and incidentally discover the secrets related to his fate and beloved ones.

title: Atash-e sabz
description: Based on an ancient story Sang-e Sabor it's the story of a girl Nardaneh who one day hears a voice telling her that soon she will marry with a dead man. One day she enters a castle and in one of it's room finds a dead body with a book beside it. She begins to read the book and follows the instructions step by step.

title: Sedotti e bidonati
description: Two rich Sicilian cousins sell their farm because they want to help two fake Siamese twins separate and then marry them. After the operation the girls are thought to be dead but then they reappear to con more money out of the two gullible men. Will they manage to do so?

title: 30:e november
description: On November 30th (the date when King Karl XII died) there will usually be demonstrations by hyper-national and neo-Nazi groups, and also democratic counter demonstrations. The plot of "West Side Story" is transferred to the Stockholmian suburb Alby where many immigrants live. But the film is no plagiarism, in particular no so because many scenes have the intensive character of live transmission. The boy (Adam) belongs to a Nazi group whose racial attitude is foremost directed against immigrants with 'wrong' colour of hair or skin. The girl (Julia) belongs to a family of political fugitives from Peru. Adam and Julia immediately fall in great and reciprocal love, and there are highly emotional love scenes. Therefore Adam breaks with his group. But when his best friend is killed by Julia's brother, he kills the brother. In turn the couple is hunted by the police and Julia's relatives. Both Adam and Julia are finally murdered. The film takes no step toward reconciliation.

title: Gharar-e bozorg
description: Amir and Reza Sooti in their youth promise to meet each other 20 years later on a special day and by putting an advertisement in the newspapers. On that special day Reza comes but Amir is late but they meet later while don't know each other and this lead to more adventures.

title: Rooban-e ghermez
description: A man and a woman fight over the rights to a property.

title: Maidan-E-Jung
description: Daata Guru (Amrish Puri) is a wealthy, powerful, and influential head of a village. He owns and controls all the villagers and their properties. Anyone who dares to raise their voice against him is crushed by his employee, Shankar (Dharmendra), and his sons, Guman (Gulshan Grover) and Karan (Akshay Kumar). title: I megali outopia
description: 1917- 2017 One century from the October Revolution. The big dream, the vision shared by millions of people over the world left an indelible mark on the 20th century. It was a utopian dream that this documentary describes and tries to interpret. The "Great Utopia" narrates the fall of the Tzar, the breakout of the "October revolution", the domination of the Bolsheviks, the civil war, the failure of "war communism", Lenin's efforts to implement the new economic policy (NEP) and the huge explosion (and subsequent implosion) of the Soviet society: social progress, free commerce, agricultural production, education, women's position, visual arts, poetry, literature, theatre, music, cinema, architecture. It was a short-lived era of creativity and the Bolsheviks dreamy of spreading it all over the world. Indeed, many communist parties sprang that ended up forming the "Communist International", an institution meant to coordinate the workers' movements in capitalist countries. Millions of people also dreamy to visit the Soviet Union and admire the accomplishments of socialism. Finally, few did so. In the meantime, in the Soviet Union, after Lenin's death, the expulsion of Trotsky and Stalin's rise, the dogma of the "war communism" comes back with a vengeance; the main goals are industrialization and collectivization, two processes that are enforced violently causing bloody conflicts with the farmers. Arrests and deportations of millions of peasants to faraway Siberia as well as an imposed famine to a large population leads to the death of more than 5 million people: the term HOLODOMOR maybe known only to the initiated; it means "death from famine" and defines the mass starvation in Ukraine in 1932-34. Immediately after, the regime, having achieved its goal, looks triumphant events and consolidates its autocracy. The prophetic painting by Nikritin "People's Trial" illustrates the tragedy.

title: Love Returns
description: A woman ends up losing everything after living a turbulent life. When she starts anew from the bottom, ironically, her life blossoms. The value that holds us together is not blood nor law, but rather love and affection between us.

title: Soulful Steps: A Soul Line Dance Journey with J&J
description: Soulful Steps sheds light on this dance style's history, evolution, and trajectory, through the lens of husband and wife team James and Jackie Rice, whose dance serves as the foundation of their romance. The birth of this dance style is due largely in part to the soulful music it uses as its backdrop. All the dances are choreographed to popular soul music. The Internet has helped the growth of the dance style's recent explosion. Soul line dancers across the world share new variations through sites like YouTube and Vimeo. We revisit their union and explore their lives, the lives of soul line dancers, and fellow teachers. Soulful Steps culminates in their creation, the first Soul Line Dancing convention on the west coast. James and Jackie met dancing 35 years ago. Jackie had just performed horribly on her nursing exam and planned to stay in the house for as long as humanly possible. Jackie's girlfriends insisted on cheering her up and drug her out to the club, to dance her blues away. James had worked all day and also had no intentions of going out. He needed go home and take a shower. His friends, however, were also insistent on taking him to the club. James had a tendency to search for the "finest woman in the room." He'd find her, talk to her, and if she responded, he was happy. If she didn't, he was ready to go. Well, on that particular night, he spotted Jackie. He felt she definitely fit his criteria, so he made his move. She obliged, and they danced the night away. They have been dancing ever since.

title: Kitty K7

title: K-Town
description: "K-Town" is a new, dynamic unscripted reality show that explores the lives of incredibly colorful Asian Americans who reside in the heart of Koreatown, Los Angeles. From karaoke bars to night clubs, the series follows the cast as they discover themselves and what it means to be Asian American growing up in the 21st century.

title: Start-Up [Hindi]
description: Young entrepreneurs aspiring to launch virtual dreams into reality compete for success and love in the cutthroat world of Korea's high-tech industry.

title: Tokyo Cabbageman K
description: The jishu film scene was an incredibly networked community, and the legendary Tokyo Cabbageman K stands as a good example. Ishii collaborator Akira Ogata-now a well-known commercial film director in his own right-shot this story of nightmarish transformation in direct reference to Kafka's The Metamorphosis with Ishii and others working on the set. When K awakens and finds himself partially transformed into a cabbage, he must come to terms with his new state and how it puts him at the center of a media storm and unsolicited desires. The film features one of the most famous soundtracks in jishu film history.

title: Gaus Electronics [Hindi]
description: Stress is no stranger to the members of Marketing Team 3 of the home appliance department at the Gaus Electronics HQ. The firm is a busy, multinational company, but this is a team that most workers dream of getting out of - and where chaos is no stranger. Some 10 employees make up the team. These include Lee Sang Sik, a man with an upbeat personality who often misjudges his coworkers' moods, causing trouble as a result. There is also Cha Na Rae, the hot-tempered assistant manager. Also among their number is Baek Ma Tan, the heir of the owners of Gaus Electronics' fiercest rival - Power Group. He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth and has never known hardship. But he shocked his entire family when he decided to join Gaus as a junior employee. His polar opposite is Geon Gang Mi, who comes from more modest origins and has always tried to pull herself up by her bootstraps - pushing herself to succeed at every step. While they seem to have very little in common at first, they slowly begin to form a bond, with possible romance sparks in the air.

description: The series is set in the near future. An automobile company named JHC Motors has created the Watch Cars, which are miniature sentient robotic cars that have become good companions to children and adults alike. Jino, one of the young Watch Car Masters, goes to the Watch Car Battle League with his Watch Car Bluewill. As the undefeated and undisputed champion of the league, Kai remains a legend. Meanwhile, the evil organization the Black Shadows attempts to eliminate all Watch Cars using their Monster Watch Cars. Can Jino, his friends Ari, Maru, Roy and their Watch-Car s overcome their hurdles? Lock and load. The most intriguing adventure has started.

title: The Enchantment
description: On August 1st, 2023, Milan's historic Odeon cinema-a true Art Nouveau architectural gem in the heart of the city-closed its doors forever. The last film to be screened was Greta Gerwig's Barbie. In its place, after demolition, yet another luxury boutique will arise. Perhaps a supermarket. Perhaps yet another urban heterotopia, unable to reconcile with it, and for it, popular passions, social life, and cultural gathering. The city seems incapable of reacting to this kind of dispossession, with culture once again falling victim to unbridled capitalism eager to swiftly devour the places of the soul. The August atmosphere certainly does not encourage the will for a tangible awakening of awareness. And yet, all the major Italian media outlets speak of the event and sing the praises of the 'great beauty' embodied by the Odeon cinema. Tomaso Pessina takes us by the hand on a journey through his dearest family memories, which are at once a memoir of the lost architecture of his city-the Odeon cinema in Milan-and an excursus on the cinemas of Pupi Avati. A door left delicately ajar onto tenderness, melancholy, remembrance, but also the magical, the miraculous, the enchanting. Through a kaleidoscope of animations, testimonies, and scenes from films, woven together by the invisible yet persistent thread of memory, the narrative unfolds as the story of a soul-that of the city itself, of Pupi Avati's filmography, and, in its most spontaneous and authentic act of identity, of the director himself.

title: Paglipay
description: The film focuses on Atan, an Aeta from Baytan village in Zambales, the Philippines, who makes a living from traditional farming system kaingin and hunting on the foothills of Mt. Pinatubo. The narrative opens as we follow Atan's fulfillment of his arranged marriage with a fellow Aeta, Ani. He has to accomplish a number of responsibilities which includes the offering of bandi or bride price to Ani's parents. Atan needs to cross the mountain river going to Banwa, the town where he could earn the necessary amount for the bride price. In order to find a job, he needs to adapt himself with the modern way of life in town, including change in appearance, manner of clothing, religious practice, and even the use of different language in order to associate himself with the Unat or 'straight-haired ones,' such as Rain, a young lass from Manila who would turn his life around. Meanwhile, Rain has to immerse with the Aetas of Banwa for her thesis, and Atan is commissioned to accompany her in research and interviews with the locals. Atan develops special feelings with Rain in his daily encounters with her. Slowly, the young Aeta forgets the very reason of his journey-the bandi, and the arrangement with Ani. In his effort to accommodate himself in a modern society, Atan faces cross-cultural modifications amid changes in the mountain brought about by immense modernity. Note: Paglipay is a Sambal Ayta term being used by Aetas when crossing the mountain river going to town.

title: Sandy Burke of the U-Bar-U
description: After Sandy Burke rescues orphaned seven-year-old Dolly Morgan from Jim Diggs, who gunned down her father, he gives her to the Widow Mackey to rear. Learning that the widow's mortgage soon is due to Digg's partner, Lafe Hinton, Sandy goes to rancher Jeff Kirby for a job, but is mistaken for desperado Slim Dillon, and captured by Kirby's daughter Molly. After Sandy proves his innocence, he masquerades as Dillon and robs a stagecoach to help the widow. Sandy wins the mortgage money playing poker with Hinton. Kirby hires Sandy to stop the thieves rustling his prize steers. Sandy suspects Diggs and Hinton, and after he rescues Molly from Diggs, he finds a letter from a packing firm which proves his suspicions. Diggs recaptures Molly, and Sandy, pursuing, falls into Diggs' trap. As Diggs prepares to brand Sandy's bare back, Molly's pleas give Sandy the opportunity to pry loose. After capturing Diggs, Sandy, who loves Molly but thinks that she loves another, says goodbye. Molly then takes his revolvers and orders him to put his hands up and around her.

title: A Cappella
description:
The movie is set in 1969, when Japanese students were enmeshed with campus riots, anti-war rallies, and the growth of subcultures in music, cinema, literature, and theater. Influenced by the atmosphere of the time, the protagonist, Kyôko, a senior at a high school for girls, forms an "Anti-Uniform Committee" and joins a rally at a university. However, Kyôko hates herself because she knows she is only copying others. One day, she is wounded at a rally, and realizes she has been taking campus riot for granted. Fleeing from the riot police, she runs into "A Cappella," the café where she meets and falls in love with a college student, named Wataru. She undergoes a sexual awakening and loses her virginity. Things seem to be going well with Wataru, but then she witnesses something she cannot believe...

 This film depicts the emotional rollercoaster of being a teenager. Love, hurt, betrayal and rebellion all play a role. "A Cappella" is a coming-of-age tale, where one finds something important and grows up by losing it

title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

title: Vhong may kakaibang epekto sa isang Miss Q&A
description:
Ang jamming at throwback vibes for this video, hatid ng "Pinoy Dream Academy" crooners na sina RJ Jimenez, Geoff Taylor, Chad Peralta at Jay-R Siaboc na may magandang balita sa fans!

Sa Miss Q and A, kakaibang comedy collab ang hatid nina Vhong Navarro, MC at Lassy, at Brent Manalo, na sanib-pwersa sa pakikipagkulitan sa tatlong kandidata.

Say hello and mabuhay sa pagdating nina Queen Natnat, MJ Perfecto, at Wri Wri Laurora, na sa talakan ay bigay na bigay. Forda kuwento si Queen tungkol sa history ng kanyang name. Heto ang chika, siya ang queen ng tatay niya, at dahil sa solid na suporta ng mga magulang, akala niya tunay siyang babae noong siya'y bata pa lamang.

Feeling reyna rin si Wri Wri, na nangatog sa kilig nang mahawakan ang crush niyang si Vhong Navarro. Hindi naman nagpatalo si Lassy, na feeling leading lady ni Brenty. Pero hindi makakapayag si MC na hindi basagin ang fantasy ni Lassy, kaya ang kuwentuhan ay nauwi sa puksaan.

Puksaan malala ang ladies na nagpaunahan sa pagpindot at pagsagot sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang tuluyang naligwak si Queen Natnat. Nagtuloy-tuloy ang chukchakan sa Wit Lang. Para sa mga hurado, 'perfecto' ang kanyang answer. Kaya naman sa araw na 'to, siya ang kinoronahang winner.

Panalo ang matapang tumalak. Parang si Ryan Bang na tumatapang sa harap ni Max Collins!

At, tamang timpla ng tapang at positivity ang perfect recipe para maging malasa ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick, kung saan mga canteen staff muna ang bumida.

Mukhang may nilulutong pag-ibig sa game arena. Ang tinginan nina Dondon at Menang, para bang may kakaibang tamis na sa puso malalasahan. Eh, sa love triangle nina Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga, at Brent Manalo, sino ang ship mo?

Matamis din ang love story ni Mylene, at mukhang ito ang nagdala sa kanya ng swerte, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante.

title: Miss Q&A Belle Tinkerbell
description:
Ang goal natin sa araw na 'to, maging masaya much. Kalimutan muna ang pighati at ang mga labi ay pintahan ng ngiti. Kalmahan muna ang mga puso, parang mga boses ng Sessionistas—Nyoy Volante, Kean Cipriano, Princss Velasco, at Sitti.

Laugh trip to the highest level kasi ang hatid nina Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Barbie Nhicole Gondra, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Kantahan sa malamig na FUNanghalian ang trip nila for today's video. Si Miss Pau, songwriting ang forte. Pagbirit naman ang talent ni Barbie. Pero lahat ng 'songerists' ay walang sinabi sa lakas ng loob ni Belle, na may balak pang mag-audition sa "Tawag Ng Tanghalan." Kaya, sample naman d'yan! Mukhang bagay nga kay Belle ang mag-TNT, dahil napansin ni Meme na kamukha nito si Sofronio Vasquez. Kaya naman si Belle, binansagan niyang Sofronia Vasquech.

Dahil benta kay Meme ang mga hirit nito, binigyan niya si Belle ng sariling entablado at pagkakataon na sagutin ang mga tanong na nabunot nina Miss Pau at Barbie sa Wit Lang round.

Kinontra ni Belle ang sagot ng dalawang kandidata. Dahil napatunayan ni Belle ang kakayahan sa tanungan, mukhang malaki ang pag-asa na makabalik siya sa Resbakan. Samantala, sa araw na 'to, kay Miss Pau ang korona bilang Reyna Talaka-Era.

Mula sa lugar na pinagmulan kasarinlan ng bayan, sumugod ang mga taga-Kawit, Cavite sa Laro Laro Pick game arena para subukan ang kanilang swerte.

Pagkatapos ng masasayang laro, ang naka-survive at umabante sa jackpot round ay ang proud housewife na si Yayie, na ilalaan ang mapapanalunan para suportahan ang pag-aaral at pangarap ng mga anak.

Para palakasin ang loob ni Yayie, binalikan ng 'Gen Z' hosts ang kanilang mga childhood dreams. Alam n'yo ba? Childhood dream ni Jackie Gonzaga na maging madre.

Back to the game, nakumbinsi ni Cianne Dominguez si Yayie na piliin ang Li-POT! Naku! Lagot! Alam pala ni Yayie ang tamang sagot!

title: Vhong, LIGWAK sa Miss Q&A hosting duties
description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.
